body:
Hi Omar,

We had a last-minute cancellation for the Tuesday morning shift at the community kitchen. Volunteers are scarce that day and we rely on coverage to serve breakfast to our guests. If you could pick up the 7 AM–11 AM slot next Tuesday, it would help keep services running.

I realize this is short notice; please let me know today so we can confirm staffing. If you can’t, no worries — I’ll continue searching for coverage.

Thanks so much,
Rita Gomez
Volunteer Coordinator

subject: Reminder: I'll reserve the court by Monday if you want to join
body:
Hi Mark,

I was thinking of reserving the squash court on Monday evening and wanted to see if you’d like to join. I’ll go ahead and book it by Monday if I don’t hear otherwise. No firm commitment required — just say yes if you can make it.

If you have a preferred time, tell me and I’ll try to align the booking. Hope to play soon.

Cheers,
Ben

subject: Your consistent late trash pickups
body:
Hello Mrs. O'Neal,

Several residents have reported that trash and recycling boxes from your unit are frequently left on the curb beyond collection times, creating an eyesore and obstructing sidewalks. This has been noted repeatedly over the last month.

We would appreciate if you could adhere to the community guidelines and return bins to your property promptly after pickup. If there are extenuating circumstances, please inform the board so we can discuss accommodations.

Sincerely,
Harborview HOA Board

subject: We need a call about the missed shipment
body:
Hi Elise,

We had a major shipment that was marked delivered but never reached our warehouse. This is already disrupting shelf availability for our top-selling product and could result in lost revenue and penalties from retailers. The operations team believes a decision from you about whether to escalate to the carrier and open a claim is necessary.

Could you call me today so we can agree on next steps and communicate with the retailer? This is important even though there isn't a formal deadline attached.

Thanks,
Bradley Yao
Account Manager

subject: Highly urgent: your sense of humor required
body:
Hi Priya,

Breaking news: our open mic lineup is tragically short on puns and dad jokes. If you are available this Friday and willing to risk public humiliation for the sake of the crowd, please drop us a one-liner or two. No formal preparation necessary — just come and wing it.

We value your irreverence and promise not to heckle (much). If you can't make it, feel free to send a recorded bit and we might play it between acts.

Best,
Jonah Reed
Open Mic House

subject: Please RSVP by Thursday if you want the extra copy
body:
Dear Ana,

We have one extra copy of this month’s selection and can bring it to the meeting if someone wants it. Please let me know by Thursday if you’d like me to reserve and bring the extra copy for you. The club meeting is the following Tuesday and the book swap usually happens informally.

This is just an offer — not a formal deadline — so if you decide later, no worries.

Warmly,
Clare Benson
Readers Circle Coordinator

subject: Please call about the billing discrepancy
body:
Hello Mr. Nguyen,

We identified several unexpected charges on your recent invoice that suggest an authorization mix-up for services rendered. We need to clarify whether those services were provided as billed or if adjustments are necessary. There is potential for account suspension if unresolved, so this is important for your account standing.

Please call our customer relations team today to review the charges and avoid service interruption. If you prefer, provide a good time and we will schedule a callback.

Sincerely,
Angela Reed
Customer Relations

subject: Immediate action required: Unauthorized sign-in detected
body:
Hi,

Our systems detected a sign-in to your Acme account from an unrecognized device in a different country at 03:12 UTC. For your protection we have temporarily locked access to sensitive areas. Please review recent activity and reset your password within the next hour to restore full access and prevent further lockout.

Click the link in your account security center to confirm the device and change your credentials. If you are unable to complete this within an hour, reply and we will open a support ticket to assist.

Thanks,
Acme Security Team

subject: Action needed: Benefit enrollment correction required today
body:
Hello Maria,

During our audit we noticed an inconsistency in your dependent information for the health plan. To ensure continued coverage, we need you to verify and correct the dependent Social Security number entry by 5:00 PM today. If the information is not corrected, enrollment may be delayed and benefits could be affected for the upcoming plan year.

Please log in to the benefits portal, select "My Dependents," and submit the corrected documentation. Contact benefits@northbridge.edu immediately if you need an extension.

Regards,
Tamara Lee, HR Operations

subject: Gas leak reported in Building B — evacuate now
body:
Dear Resident,

Maintenance reported the smell of natural gas in Building B at 2:45 PM and emergency crews are on the way. For your safety please evacuate the building immediately and assemble at the north parking lot behind the management office. Do not use elevators or open flames.

We will provide updates via text and email as soon as the building is cleared. If you require assistance leaving the building, reply to this message with your apartment number and we will prioritize help.

Stay safe,
Carlos Mendes, Greenridge Facilities

subject: Urgent: Signature required for wire authorization
body:
Hi Jonathan,

We received a request to wire $95,000 from your corporate account yesterday. Under bank policy we require an in-person signature or a notarized authorization before proceeding. If this wire was authorized by you, please come to the downtown branch before close of business today to complete the required paperwork. If you did not authorize this transaction, contact our fraud hotline immediately at 1-800-555-1212 so we can freeze the account and investigate.

Regards,
Elena Park, Commercial Banking — FinTrust

subject: Final decision required for thesis defense committee (ASAP)
body:
Hi Priya,

Congratulations on completing your thesis draft. The graduate office must confirm your defense committee composition before they can schedule a defense date. Please confirm acceptance or propose an alternate member for Dr. Lee by 10:00 AM tomorrow so we can finalize the calendar for next week. This is time-sensitive because the committee members’ availability is limited and the defense must occur before the graduation paperwork deadline.

Reply with your confirmation or proposed replacement and I’ll forward to the graduate office immediately.

Best,
Mark Daniels

subject: Quick favor: 2-minute survey by Friday
body:
Hi there,

We hope you are doing well. As part of our alumni engagement efforts, we’d appreciate if you could take a short two-minute survey about your experience at StateU. Your responses will help shape upcoming events and communications. The survey will remain open until Friday, and though it isn’t mandatory, your feedback is valuable.

Please click the link below to begin. If you’ve already completed it, thank you — we truly appreciate your time and responses.

Warmly,
StateU Alumni Relations

subject: Reminder: Apply for voter assistance by Monday
body:
Good afternoon,

This is a friendly reminder that applications for mail-in voter assistance must be submitted by Monday evening to be processed for the upcoming municipal election. If you need assistance filling out the form, you may visit the clerk’s office during business hours or call us for guidance. Missing the application deadline will mean you must vote in person.

Thank you for taking part in our civic process. Links to the application and instructions are below.

Sincerely,
Meaderville Town Clerk's Office

subject: Complete new hire paperwork by Friday
body:
Hello Angela,

Welcome aboard! To finalize your employment package, please complete the remaining onboarding forms in the employee portal by Friday. The outstanding items include tax forms and direct deposit setup. Completing these by the deadline ensures payroll and benefits enrollment proceed smoothly for your first paycheck.

If you encounter any issues with the portal, let me know and I’ll arrange a quick call to walk through the steps.

Best regards,
Simon Patel, Talent Acquisition — TechLoom

subject: Sign up for holiday shifts — slots close Wednesday
body:
Hi Emma,

Thank you for offering to volunteer this season. We’re finalizing holiday shift assignments and will close sign-ups on Wednesday night. If you have a preferred shift, please log into the volunteer portal and select your availability before then. While we can sometimes accommodate late changes, filling your slot now helps our event coordinators plan roles and training.

If none of the listed times work, reply and we’ll try to match you to an alternate task.

Thanks,
Lena Moreno, Oakridge Community Center

subject: Your order #841209 has shipped
body:
Hello Chris,

Good news — your Shoply order #841209 has shipped and is on its way. The package is scheduled for delivery in three to five business days and includes tracking information below. If you need to change the delivery address or request hold options, please contact our customer service within 24 hours.

We hope you enjoy your purchase. If anything arrives damaged or missing, open a case through your order history and we’ll assist with a return or replacement.

Thanks for shopping with Shoply,
Customer Care

subject: Today’s top headlines — Monday morning roundup
body:
Good morning,

Here is your Monday news roundup: political developments, market updates, and feature stories to start your week. This digest highlights major stories and links to in-depth coverage, curated by our editorial team. There’s no immediate action required; it’s just a quick summary to keep you informed.

If you prefer a different mix of topics, update your preferences on our website and we’ll tailor future digests to your interests.

Best,
The Daily Brief Editorial Team

subject: Your monthly lab results are available
body:
Hi Aaron,

Your routine lab results from last week are now posted to your MyHealth portal. The primary care team reviewed the numbers and noted everything is within expected ranges. No action is necessary unless you have specific questions or symptoms to discuss.

If you’d like a follow-up appointment to review the results with your physician, you can schedule one through the portal or call our office. Otherwise, we’ll see you at your next routine check-in.

Kind regards,
MyHealth Clinic

subject: Monthly newsletter: July neighborhood updates
body:
Hello Neighbor,

Welcome to the Elmwood Watch July newsletter. This month’s issue covers recent safety tips, upcoming meetings, volunteer opportunities, and a short report on local patrol activity. It’s intended as an informational update — no immediate action is required unless you want to sign up for patrol shifts or report items to the board.

Thanks for staying engaged with the community. Meeting details and sign-up links are provided below.

Sincerely,
Elmwood Neighborhood Watch Committee

subject: Reminder: Your subscription renews on August 1
body:
Hi Jordan,

This is a friendly reminder that your StreamFlix subscription will auto-renew on August 1. No action is required unless you wish to change your plan or cancel before renewal. If you want to modify your billing method or switch to an annual plan, visit your account settings.

We’ve added some new shows this month you might enjoy. If you have any questions about charges, our support team is available via chat.

Thanks for watching,
The StreamFlix Team

subject: Weekly logistics summary — routes and delays
body:
Hi Team,

Attached is the weekly logistics summary outlining route performance, on-time percentages, and a brief list of delays experienced last week. This is an automated report for your review and planning — no immediate response required. The operations manager will review trends at next week’s stand-up if you want to raise any concerns.

Please archive the report in the shared drive and reference it during planning sessions.

Regards,
DeliveryHub Automated Reports

subject: URGENT: Someone ate the avocado toast
body:
Hey Zoe,

Urgent news: the avocado toast I meticulously prepared this morning is missing from the fridge. Clearly this is a national emergency and the brunch crisis team should convene immediately. If you have any leads, surveillance footage, or cupcake alibis, now is the time to come forward.

On a serious note, if you grabbed it by mistake, no big deal — just confess and I’ll forgive you with maybe a muffin. See you for coffee later.

— Mia

subject: Emergency: Our prices are falling (act like it matters)
body:
Hello Shopper,

ALERT: Prices are tumbling like a dramatic soap-opera cliffhanger. This once-in-a-small-window offer is obviously the end of the world if you don’t buy socks in the next 48 hours. Or not. But seriously, there are some decent discounts on summer essentials and we thought you might want to know.

No need to call a rescue squad; just browse our sale and do with the urgency whatever you usually do on a Tuesday. Happy scrolling!

Cheers,
The FlashSales Team

subject: Need approval before we lock the designs
body:
Hi Daniel,

The client loved the mockups and asked us to lock the final design before their production sprint. We plan to finalize everything Wednesday morning so the development team can begin implementation on Thursday. If you have any comments, changes, or objections, please send them over tonight so I can incorporate them before locking the files.

If you don’t respond, I’ll assume you approve and proceed with the current assets. Let me know if you’d like a quick call to walk through specifics.

Thanks,
Amelia

subject: Speaker list finalization ahead of print
body:
Hello Dr. Okoye,

Thanks again for agreeing to join the panel. We’re sending the speaker roster to the printer on Friday to prepare the badge packets. If you have any last-minute title updates or bio corrections, please email them to me by Thursday evening. After that point we won’t be able to change printed materials.

If everything is unchanged, no action is required and we’ll use the information on file. Looking forward to your session.

Warm regards,
Priya Nair, OpenAI Summit Program Team

subject: This is unacceptable — loud parties every weekend
body:
Landlord,

I’ve reached out multiple times about the noise coming from 3B and yet nothing has changed. Last weekend the music continued until past 2 AM and my children were unable to sleep. I pay rent on time and expect reasonable peace; this repeated disturbance is unacceptable.

I’m asking you to address this matter with the tenants of 3B and enforce the building quiet hours. If this continues, I will document occurrences and escalate to the housing authority. Please respond with your plan.

Sincerely,
Ryan Caldwell

subject: URGENT SALE: Limited window to score huge discounts!
body:
Dear Customer,

URGENT: Don’t miss our limited window sale! We’ve slashed prices across the site for a short time. This is a marketing push to clear inventory and while it says urgent, it’s just our way of encouraging quick decisions. Browse categories like electronics and home goods to see the markdowns.

If you prefer not to receive urgent-style notifications, update your email preferences. No actual emergency — just deals.

Best,
SuperDiscounts Sales Team

subject: We need to talk about last month’s deliverable
body:
Hi Priyanka,

I reviewed the deliverable we received last week and several items do not align with the scope we agreed upon. This has created a problem for our board presentation next month and we need to discuss how to bring the work up to standard. There isn’t a formal deadline in this message, but we need to resolve the issues before the board meets on the 18th.

Please call me today or tomorrow to set a remediation plan. If we can’t resolve this promptly we may have to consider alternate providers.

Regards,
Eleanor Bates

subject: Urgent concern from multiple parents regarding aftercare safety
body:
Dear Ms. Alvarez,

Several parents have reported incidents related to aftercare supervision that raise safety concerns. While no single email included a formal complaint, this cluster of reports suggests a pattern that could expose the school to liability if not addressed. We need a meeting with administration to review policies and staffing before next week’s aftercare sessions resume at full capacity.

Please let us know your availability for a meeting this week so we can work together on immediate safeguards.

Sincerely,
Maya Rodriguez, PTA Chair

subject: I’ll be in town by Friday — catch up?
body:
Hey Sam,

Long time no see! I’m going to be in your city for a few days and I’ll stop by Friday afternoon if you’re around. No big plans — thought we could grab a quick coffee or take a walk by the river. I don’t need an RSVP; just let me know if you’d like to meet and what time might work.

If Friday doesn’t suit, we can aim for the weekend. Hope you’re well and looking forward to catching up.

Cheers,
Owen

subject: Flight change notice: 7:30 AM -> 9:05 AM
body:
Dear Passenger,

We are writing to inform you that Flight BA412 from Portland to Denver originally scheduled for 7:30 AM has been rescheduled to depart at 9:05 AM due to crew logistics. We apologize for the inconvenience. No action is required if you accept the updated time; if the new schedule does not work, you may request a rebooking or refund through our website or customer service line.

We appreciate your patience and look forward to serving you.

Sincerely,
BlueAirlines Customer Care

subject: VERY IMPORTANT: Free donuts in the break room
body:
Hey Team,

This is a very important announcement: there are free donuts in the break room. I repeat, extremely critical. Please drop everything and secure your glazed pastry immediately. For those who prefer fruit, there may be a lone, misunderstood apple hiding behind the coffee maker.

All jokes aside, stop by between 10 and 11 if you want one. No formal meeting required; just fuel and morale. See you there.

— Jenn

subject: Appalling service — refund my money
body:
To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to express my frustration with the service I received last week. Despite following all instructions, my order arrived damaged and customer support was unhelpful. This experience has been incredibly disappointing and I expect a full refund and compensation for the inconvenience.

Please respond with confirmation of the refund and the timeline for when I will receive it. If I do not hear back within three business days, I will escalate the matter through consumer protection channels.

Regards,
Patricia Gomez

subject: Final NOTICE: Clearance items must go!
body:
Hello,

FINAL NOTICE — clearance items must go. Okay, perhaps not an actual legal ultimatum, but our warehouse is full and we’re trying to make room for fall inventory. Check out the clearance section for discounted apparel and equipment. Quantities are limited and prices are unlikely to last long — standard marketing language, not a court summons.

If you want to be removed from these notices, update your preferences. Happy shopping!

Best,
FitPlus Deals

subject: Account compromise detected — immediate password reset required
body:
Hello,

Our monitoring has detected suspicious activity originating from your account this morning, including multiple failed API calls and a login from an unfamiliar IP. For your protection, we require you to confirm your identity and reset your password within the next two hours. Follow the secure link in your account portal (do not use any emailed links) and enable the recommended two-factor authentication. If you are unable to complete this now, reply to this message and we will schedule a verification call.

Thank you,
IT Security Team

subject: Immediate: Sign your termination paperwork by 5 PM today
body:
Hi,

I’m writing to inform you that HR needs your signed separation paperwork to process your final paycheck and benefits continuation. The processing deadline is 5:00 PM today so we can finalize payroll for the week. You can review and sign the documents in Workday under Tasks -> Pending Documents. If you cannot access Workday, please call me immediately at the number below so we can arrange an alternate method.

Regards,
Linda Cho
HR Manager

subject: Gas leak reported in Building C — evacuate now
body:
Good morning,

Emergency services have reported a possible gas leak in Building C. Please evacuate the building immediately and proceed to the East Lawn assembly point. Do not use elevators. Facilities staff are coordinating with campus police and the utility provider; once cleared you will receive an all-clear notification. If anyone requires assistance exiting, identify yourself to building staff or call campus security right away.

Stay safe,
Campus Facilities

subject: Response required: subpoena for client documents
body:
Dear Partner,

We received a subpoena requesting specific client records related to transaction X. The court requires a formal response and production: if we do not respond by the deadline outlined in the attached notice, sanctions could follow. I need you to confirm within four hours whether any responsive documents exist in your files and authorize counsel to proceed with redactions. Please reply with a brief statement of holdings and availability for a short call within the hour.

Best,
Marcus Hale
Legal Intake

subject: Please confirm surgery consent — procedure tomorrow
body:
Hello,

This is a reminder that your scheduled procedure is tomorrow morning. We still need your signed consent form and a confirmation of your pre-op medication list. Please complete the attached consent and return it via the patient portal by 8 PM tonight so the surgical team can proceed with final preparations. If you cannot sign electronically, call our office immediately to arrange an in-person or faxed signature.

Sincerely,
Surgical Scheduling
City Hospital

subject: Course feedback survey due Wednesday
body:
Hi there,

As the semester wraps up, we’d really appreciate five minutes of your time to fill out the course feedback survey for HIST 210. The survey helps instructors improve course materials and will be open until Wednesday at midnight. Your responses are anonymous and will guide curriculum planning for next year. If you prefer, you can drop by the department office and fill a paper copy.

Thanks for your input,
Department of History

subject: Open enrollment change form — submit by Friday
body:
Hello,

Open enrollment is underway. If you plan to change your health or dental coverage for the next plan year, please complete the online enrollment change form by this Friday. Changes submitted after that date will not take effect until the next plan year. This is a routine administrative window; if you do nothing, your current elections will roll over.

Best,
Benefits Team

subject: Volunteer hour logs due next Monday
body:
Dear Volunteer,

Thank you for helping at the summer reading program. To ensure we credit your service hours, please submit your volunteer hour log by next Monday. The form is attached and can be emailed back to me or dropped off at the front desk. This deadline helps us compile reports for the town council and for students seeking verification letters.

Warmly,
Erin Park
Volunteer Coordinator

subject: Speaker bio & slides needed before Tuesday
body:
Hi,

Thanks again for agreeing to speak at GreenBiz Summit. To ensure program materials are ready, please send your 50–75 word bio and final slides no later than Tuesday. We will include your bio in the event guide and upload slides to the speaker portal. If you miss this deadline we may not be able to feature your session materials in the printed program, but you can still present live.

Regards,
Conference Team

subject: Your order has shipped — tracking included
body:
Hi Sarah,

Good news: your order #U-48291 has shipped and is on its way. You can track the package using the tracking number below. Delivery is estimated within 3–5 business days. If you need to change the delivery address, contact customer service; otherwise no action is required.

Thank you for shopping with UrbanStyle!
Customer Care

subject: This week's top product reviews and analysis
body:
Hello,

Welcome to this week’s TechWeekly Roundup. We’ve curated articles on the latest smartphone releases, an in-depth comparison of noise-cancelling headphones, and a feature on sustainable manufacturing practices in consumer electronics. Also included are quick links to developer tools updates and a short interview with a startup founder.

If you’d like to unsubscribe or change preferences, use the link at the bottom of the newsletter.

Best,
TechWeekly Team

subject: Your weekly activity summary is ready
body:
Hi Alex,

Here’s your activity summary for the week: you completed 4 workouts, logged two outdoor runs, and met your step goal on three days. Great progress on consistency! If you want tailored training suggestions, tap the Recommendations tab in the app. No immediate action is required unless you want to change your goals.

Keep it up,
FitTrack

subject: Monthly statement available
body:
Dear Customer,

Your monthly bank statement is now available on online banking. Review the transactions and reach out if you see any unauthorized activity. This is a routine notification; no action is necessary unless you would like to dispute a charge. For security reasons we never ask for your full password via email.

Sincerely,
Community Bank

subject: Garden club meeting notes and photos
body:
Hi Neighbors,

Thanks to everyone who attended Saturday’s garden club. Attached are the meeting notes and a few photos from the plant exchange. We discussed drought-tolerant species and mulching techniques; minutes include recommended plant lists. If you volunteered for the community planting day, we’ll follow up separately with logistics. Otherwise this email is just to keep everyone in the loop.

Warm regards,
Elm Street Garden Club

subject: Flight schedule update — no change to your booking
body:
Hello,

We reviewed your upcoming flight itinerary and wanted to let you know there are no schedule changes at this time. We’ll notify you promptly if anything changes. If you’d like to view your reservation or manage seats, visit the Manage My Booking page. This is an informational message only.

Safe travels,
SkyWide Customer Service

subject: New episodes added this month
body:
Hi,

We’ve added several new series and movies to our catalog this month, including the anticipated drama series and a collection of classic documentaries. Check out curated playlists based on your watch history for recommendations. No action is required; this is just a heads-up about new content.

Enjoy,
StreamFlix

subject: URGENT: The world ends at 5pm
body:
Hey,

Please drop what you’re doing — the world is apparently ending at 5pm, so we absolutely must finalize the color palette for the summer banner before the apocalypse. In all seriousness, I’ll be in the design lounge with coffee and sarcasm if anyone wants to brainstorm for ten minutes. If you have strong feelings about teal versus turquoise, now is the time to share them.

Cheers,
Pete
Senior Designer

subject: Need confirmation to proceed with the produce shipment
body:
Hi Maria,

We have perishable items scheduled for pickup at the supplier tomorrow morning. Our carrier cannot load the pallet unless you confirm the billing account and delivery instructions. If we don’t hear from you this afternoon, the shipment will be held and likely delayed a day, which could affect product freshness for the Friday market. Please reply with confirmation or delegate to someone on your team to avoid delays.

Thanks,
Jorge
Wholesale Operations

subject: Are you available to foster the Labrador this weekend?
body:
Hello,

We have a Labrador who needs a temporary foster placement over the weekend due to an unexpected kennel closure. If you’re able to help, let me know and we’ll drop off the supplies. If not, no worries — we’ll keep asking in the volunteer channel. Ideally we’d like a yes or no today so we can plan pickups, but if you need a bit more time, just tell me when you’ll know.

Appreciatively,
Maggie
Foster Coordinator

subject: This is unacceptable — poor service last night
body:
To whom it may concern,

I’m writing because the technician sent to my house last night arrived late, left a mess, and failed to complete the repair. I expected better from a company that charges premium rates. I’ve lost confidence and want a refund for the service call. This experience was frustrating and inconvenient; please let me know how you plan to make this right.

Regards,
Franklin Bates

subject: Your loud music again at 2 AM
body:
Hi,

This is the third night this week that loud music from your apartment kept our baby awake until the early hours. I had hoped a polite knock would suffice, but it hasn’t. Please keep the noise down, especially after 10 PM. If this continues, I’ll be forced to involve building management. I don’t want that, but this is disrupting sleep and work schedules for our family.

Thanks,
Danielle

subject: URGENT SALE: 99% off for the next 24 hours!
body:
Dear Shopper,

Don’t miss our urgent sale — 99% off sitewide for the next 24 hours only! This is a limited-time, stock-clearance event with doorbuster prices. Add items to your cart now; quantities are extremely limited and items may sell out at any moment. Click through to reveal the hidden discount codes at checkout. Act fast to secure unbelievable savings!

Happy savings,
BargainBlast Deals

subject: Serious concerns about project deliverables — please call
body:
Hi Jordan,

I need to speak with you as soon as possible. Our board reviewed the most recent deliverable and raised significant concerns about accuracy and client alignment; stakeholders were surprised and are asking for clarification. This is jeopardizing the account relationship. I don’t want to escalate further without hearing your side. Please call me today when you are available; I will be on my mobile all afternoon.

Thanks,
Maria Alvarez
Client Relations

subject: I'll swing by by Friday — picnic details
body:
Hi,

Just a quick note to say I’ll swing by your place by Friday with the potato salad and a few games for the picnic. No rush on planning — I figured I’d arrive in the early afternoon depending on traffic. If your plans change, send a quick text. Looking forward to catching up and meeting everyone; bring the comfy blankets and I’ll handle cups and utensils.

See you soon,
Sophie

subject: Membership renewal reminder
body:
Hello,

This is a friendly reminder that your annual gym membership will auto-renew next month. If you would like to change your plan or cancel, please do so through your account settings before the renewal date. Otherwise, no action is required and your membership will continue uninterrupted.

Best,
PeakFit Support

subject: Hours change for the holidays
body:
Dear Members,

Please note the community center will have altered hours over the upcoming holidays. We are sending this for your planning convenience. All scheduled classes will show adjusted times on the online calendar. If you usually attend evening classes, please check the updated schedule so you don’t arrive to a closed facility.

Thank you,
Riverdale Community Center

subject: Delivery exception: slight delay to your package
body:
Hi,

We wanted to inform you that your order is experiencing a short delay in transit due to a carrier logistics issue. We expect delivery within two additional business days. No action is required on your part; we will continue to monitor the shipment and notify you once it is out for delivery. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
Artisan Bazaar Support

subject: Quick confirmation needed for matching funds allocation
body:
Dear Dr. Patel,

Congratulations on the fund award. Before we can finalize the disbursement, our finance office needs written confirmation of the matching funds source so we can complete the grant agreement. The fiscal team will begin processing next week and prefers to lock in the matched amounts prior to release. If you can send the confirmation by end of day tomorrow, we can include it in this cohort; if not, disbursement may shift to the following cycle.

Warm regards,
Evelyn Chen
Grants Officer

subject: Immediate action required: Unusual login detected on your account
body:
Hi Jordan,

We detected multiple failed login attempts to your Acme account from an unfamiliar IP address this morning. For your protection, we have temporarily suspended some account activities. Please reset your password and review recent sessions using the secure link below within the next 2 hours to avoid extended suspension.

If you did not attempt these logins, contact our security desk immediately at 1-800-555-SEC or reply to this message and we will prioritize the incident.

Thanks,
IT Security Team
Acme Corporation

subject: Signature needed for closing docs today
body:
Hello Michael,

We received the buyer's last-minute revisions. The lender requires your signature on the amended closing disclosure before 5:00 PM today in order to keep the scheduled closing at 11:00 AM tomorrow. This is time-sensitive — without your signature, the lender may delay funding and closing could be postponed.

I've attached the document and can join a quick call to walk you through any changes. Please sign electronically and confirm when complete.

Best regards,
Emily Park
Lawson Partners

subject: Follow-up: Abnormal lab results — please call today
body:
Dear Ms. Chen,

Your recent bloodwork shows an abnormal potassium level that can sometimes require prompt adjustment of medications. This is not a routine result and we need to review your current prescriptions and symptoms as soon as possible.

Please call our nurse line today at (555) 123-4000 before 6:00 PM so we can advise whether any immediate changes are needed. If you are experiencing dizziness, palpitations, or shortness of breath, go to the nearest ER now.

Sincerely,
Dr. Maria Alvarez
Central Clinic

subject: Last call: Confirm your speaker availability for keynote session
body:
Hi Alex,

StartupX

body:

Please have your project lead contact me to explain what the holdup is and a concrete timeline for completion. I expect this to be addressed without more back-and-forth.

Regards,
Charles Hamilton

Client Services
Brightford Consulting

body:
Hello Dr. Perez,

The review panel scheduled to evaluate your grant application meets next Wednesday. They returned a short list of clarifying questions and asked that we provide revised budget notes and a one-page methods clarification before the review so they can include it in their packet.

Hillside Foundation

Please address the lease terms with the tenants involved and enforce quiet hours. I expect some action so we don't have to escalate this further.

Thanks,
Leo Ramirez
Apt 5B

Mom

IT Security Team

body:
Hi,

We received the client's redlined contract this morning with several cost and milestone changes. The legal team is asking for our formal position before they send the counteroffer. I need your decision on whether to accept the scope and new payment schedule or request revisions. Our window to respond is narrow — the client intends to finalize terms at tomorrow's procurement meeting at 12:00pm.

Please reply with your preference (accept / negotiate / decline) and any notes I should include. If you prefer to talk it through, I can be available for a quick call this afternoon.

Best,
Sarah

body:
Dear Patient,

Your recent bloodwork showed a critical potassium level that requires immediate clinical review. We flagged the value and held the report so your primary care physician can discuss next steps. Please contact Dr. Patel's office today as soon as possible for further instructions; if you are experiencing palpitations, dizziness, or shortness of breath, seek emergency care.

If you cannot reach your doctor, call our triage line and we will coordinate an urgent appointment. We understand this is stressful — we are here to help get you prompt follow-up.

Sincerely,
St. Mary's Laboratory Services

Please reply to this email or call our fraud hotline within 24 hours to confirm or dispute the transfer. If we do not hear from you, the hold will convert to a provisional reversal and additional verification steps will be required to restore normal outgoing capabilities.

Do not share any account passwords via email. If you did not authorize this transfer, contact us immediately so we can take protective measures.

Thank you,
First National Bank — Fraud Prevention

Community Wellness Team

body:

Maplewood Neighborhood Association

body:
Hey,

Huge emergency: if you don't make it to dinner tonight, civilization as we know it might collapse. Kidding — but seriously, we booked a table for 7:30 and I need a head count. If you bail, I'll be forced to order extra garlic bread and maybe cry a little.

No pressure at all, unless you hate garlic bread. Reply to confirm whether you're coming; if not, I will personally judge your life choices.

See ya,
Elliot

body:
Hi Team,

As we prepare for the production cutover, engineering needs the final component specs and integration notes so we can validate the deployment. We don't have a formal deadline on the spreadsheet, but the release is scheduled to begin once those docs are in. If we miss the handoff window, the deployment will slip and cascade into the next sprint.

Please upload your finalized docs to the repo today or message me with blockers. If you can't finish today, tell me what remains so I can coordinate a hotfix timeline.

Thanks,
Priya

subject: You Parked in My Spot Again
body:
Hello,

I am writing because your car has repeatedly been parked in the visitor spot in front of my building. This is the third time this month, and it's incredibly frustrating. I work odd hours and that parking space is how I manage my schedule. I expect neighbors to be considerate.

Please stop using that spot or I will have to speak to building management. I don't want to escalate, but I will if this continues.

-Mark

body:

FlashDeals Team

subject: URGENT: The plants are staging a revolt
body:
Hey you,

Not to alarm you, but the basil and the fern have formed a coalition and are demanding water and sunlight. Clearly this is a matter of life and death for the foliage, so I’m putting out an emergency plea. If you could just remember to water them this week that would restore peace to the apartment and prevent the indoor rainforest from going feral.

I’m kidding about the revolt, but seriously—can you handle watering on Thursday? Thanks for being the plant whisperer.

—Sam

subject: We need to talk about your late-night gatherings
body:
Hello,

Several neighbors have reported loud music and late-night noise coming from your unit over the past two weekends. This disruption has been ongoing and several residents have expressed frustration. While we prefer to resolve these matters informally, the repeated complaints are straining community relations.

Please be mindful of quiet hours and take steps to reduce the noise. If this continues, the HOA board will need to escalate the matter. We appreciate your cooperation in keeping Elm Street pleasant for everyone.

Regards,
Elm Street HOA Board

Hi Shopper,

subject: Slide deck for tomorrow’s 9 AM demo
body:
Hi Chris,

We’re demonstrating the prototype to the client at 9 AM tomorrow and the product walkthrough needs to be finalized. The team is counting on your section — integration notes and the updated architecture diagram — so we can rehearse tonight. There isn’t an explicit ‘deadline’ in the calendar invite, but without your slides the rehearsal can’t proceed and the demo could be affected.

Can you upload your slide deck to the shared folder before 6 PM this evening so we can consolidate and run through the full script?

Thanks,
Nora

subject: Catch up soon — I'll stop by Friday
body:
Hey Miguel,

Long time no see! I’m going to be in your neighborhood this week and I’ll probably stop by Friday to drop off that book I promised. No pressure at all — if you’re around it would be great to grab a quick coffee, but if not I can leave the book on your porch. Either way, just let me know what works for you and I’ll be flexible.

Hope everything’s well with you. Talk soon!

—Maria

body:
Hi Leo,

I’m reaching out because the client called me this morning upset about the social campaign metrics and unexpected negative comments. They want to escalate and would like to speak with the account lead as soon as possible to discuss remedies. There isn’t a strict deadline, but this is high stakes for our relationship and could impact future work if not addressed promptly.

Please call me when you’re free today so we can coordinate a response and propose next steps. I’ll be on Slack all afternoon.

Best,
Vanessa
Senior Account Manager

Thanks,
MarketNow Team

body:
Dear Members,

In an utterly catastrophic turn of events, the baked goods committee has failed to produce a schedule for cookie tasting next month. As the situation teeters on the brink of chaos, we humbly request one volunteer to take over biscuit logistics. If no one steps forward, we might have to rely on store-bought samples, and the horror is almost too great to contemplate.

If you can spare thirty minutes to help, please reply. Your heroism will be remembered in perpetuity (or at least until the next meeting).

Warmly,
Cassie
Bookbinders Club President

Managing Editor

See you Friday,
Marc

Regards,
Samantha Lee

Best,

body:

Admissions Office

Warmly,

Riverside Book Club

body:
Hello Laura,

I have tried to be patient but the music from your apartment has been extremely loud late into the night for several weekends. It wakes my children and makes it impossible to sleep. I have called the building manager twice and nothing has changed. I expect you to address this matter immediately and keep the volume down after 10 PM. If the situation continues, I will escalate to the landlord and consider filing a formal complaint.

Sincerely,
Gary Knox

body:

They want to speak with someone from senior management and said they expect an immediate plan to recover performance. Please call me at your earliest convenience so we can prepare talking points.

Regards,

Client Relations

Just wanted to say I'll be over Friday to drop off the pies I promised and see how that new bird feeder is doing. I'll probably only stay half an hour — no need to rearrange any plans, I can pop them through the door if you're not home. It would be lovely to catch up briefly, but truly don't worry if you're busy. Sending love to you and the kids.

Love,
Grandma

Legal Partners LLP

Harbor Clinic

Compliance, FinTrust Bank

Awaiting your response.

— David

subject: We need to talk — several clients are upset

Best,
Marco Ruiz
Atlas Consulting

Hey Tom,

I wanted to pass along a couple of recommendations from my recent trip and hear how your new role is going.

Cheers,
Melissa

No action necessary — this is just a heads-up. If you want personalized recommendations, check out the Picks for You page.

Enjoy,
CinemaHub

body:
Hello Team,

Our annual company picnic is next Saturday at Riverside Park from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM. We’ll provide lunch and family-friendly activities. Please RSVP by filling out the event form so we can plan food and seating. If you have dietary restrictions, include them in the form.

Best,

Hi Carla,

ALERT — our inventory clear-out is ending and we’ve applied urgent markdowns sitewide. Hundreds of items are deeply discounted and priced to move. This promotional email highlights best-sellers and bundle deals that change throughout the day. No commitment required; browse now and pay later with our installment option.

If you frequently miss our sales, consider subscribing to SMS alerts for real-time updates. Thanks for being a valued customer.

Sincerely,
Trendify Sales

subject: Quick OK needed on headline before layout tomorrow
body:
Hi Neal,

We’re finalizing the feature layout and the designer needs to lock the headline treatment tonight to meet printing deadlines. I tweaked the headline for clarity and attached the suggested copy. If you have any objections or alternate wording, please send them through within the next few hours so we can adjust the layout. If I don’t hear from you, I will proceed with the revision as edited.

Appreciate a quick read — printing schedule is tight.

Thanks,
Marta

subject: You and your late-night parties!
body:
Hi,

I’m writing because the noise from your apartment has been unacceptable for weeks. Music blares loudly past midnight, and last weekend there were shouting and guests in the hallway at 2 AM. I’ve had to lose sleep and I work early shifts. This isn’t just inconvenient — it’s disrespectful. I’ve tried polite knocks and messages, but the behavior hasn’t changed.

I’d appreciate it if you could keep it down and be mindful of shared building quiet hours. If it continues, I’ll have to escalate to building management.

— Chris

subject: Can you review the deck? I’ll swing by Friday with notes
body:
Hey Hannah,

I skimmed your deck and I’ll swing by Friday with some handwritten notes and a few thoughts on the slides that might tighten the narrative. No need to rework anything urgently on your end — this is just my informal pass-through so we can chat in person. If you’d like me to look sooner, leave a comment on Slide 3 and I’ll prioritize it.

Looking forward to our catch-up and to seeing how the client response shapes up.

Best,
Tim

subject: Immediate: Signature required on NDA within 24 hours
body:
Hi Alex,

We need your signature on the attached NDA to finalize the vendor engagement. Legal flagged a term that requires your explicit approval before we can proceed with onboarding. The procurement team has scheduled the kickoff for Monday morning and cannot confirm the contractor until the NDA is signed.

Please review and e-sign the document by tomorrow, 4 PM, so I can confirm with procurement. If you have concerns about clause 7 or require redlines, tell me immediately and I’ll escalate to legal, but we need your decision today to avoid delaying the start date.

Thanks,
Lara

subject: Account security: Unrecognized sign-in — action required now
body:
Dear Customer,

We detected an unrecognized sign-in to your online banking from a new device and location. For your protection, we have temporarily restricted certain account actions. Please log in and complete the multi-factor verification to confirm it was you.

If you do not complete verification within two hours, we will escalate to a full lockout and reach out by phone. If you did not attempt this sign-in, please immediately reset your password and contact our fraud team at 1-800-555-0199 so we can review recent transactions and secure your account.

Sincerely,
BankNorth Security Team

subject: Critical lab result — please call the clinic today
body:
Hello Jordan,

I’m writing with an important update regarding your recent blood tests. One of the values came back outside the expected range and could indicate a condition that benefits from prompt evaluation. Although it may be benign, I’d like to discuss the results and next steps before the end of today.

Please call the clinic at your earliest convenience; if you cannot make it today, tell us a time tomorrow morning and we will prioritize you. If you are experiencing any new symptoms such as chest pain, shortness of breath, or fainting, please go to the nearest emergency department immediately.

Best regards,
Dr. Shah

subject: Action needed: Approve emergency rollback for payment API
body:
Hi Casey,

The on-call team can perform an emergency rollback to the previous stable release, but we need your approval to proceed because it will affect feature flags that your team manages.

If you approve, we will schedule the rollback within the hour and monitor closely. If you prefer a patch instead, we need your input on the patch strategy immediately so we don’t exceed the window. Please reply with “approve rollback” or propose a patch plan right away.

Thanks,
Miguel — IT Operations

subject: Flight rebooking required for disrupted itinerary — respond today

Warm regards,
Delta Reservations

body:
Hello,

Best wishes,
Oakville Clinic Scheduling

subject: URGENT: Coffee supply critically endangered
body:
Hey,

I’m sending this with the gravest possible tone: the office coffee is down to two pods and the situation is dire. Momentum could collapse. Meetings will be canceled. Productivity will nosedive. I expect coordinated action and a battalion of volunteers armed with single-serve machines.

All sarcasm aside, could someone pick up a refill on their way in? I’ll handle the reimbursement — no need to escalate to upper management or call emergency services. Just a small coffee run would stave off internal chaos.

Thanks,
Mark

subject: Need final hero image before tomorrow morning's review
body:
Hi Diego,

The product team wants to include the hero banner in tomorrow morning’s stakeholder review. I’ll be compiling slides tonight and need the final hero image and alt text before I lock the deck. There’s not an explicit “deadline” in the calendar invite, but the review is at 9 AM and I can’t present mockups without your approved asset.

If there are unresolved concerns with the current version, send your notes now and I’ll coordinate with the content writer to adapt. Otherwise, please upload the final file to the assets folder by tonight so I can include it.

Cheers,
Ana

subject: Unacceptable — common area mess again
body:
Hello Residents,

I am writing about the recurring mess in the laundry room and common kitchen. It’s infuriating to walk in and find dishes piled up, spills ignored, and personal items left overnight. This behavior is disrespectful to others who share the space and to the staff who maintain the building.

This notice is to call attention and request everyone’s cooperation in cleaning up immediately after use. Continued disregard for shared spaces may result in fines per building policy, but I hope we can resolve this without enforcement. Please be considerate.

Regards,
Kevin, Building Manager

subject: URGENT SALE: Prices may change in minutes!
body:
Hi Shopper,

Best,
FlashDeals Team

subject: We need to talk about last week's campaign — please call
body:
Hi Paul,

I read the post-campaign analytics this morning and there are several discrepancies between the reported metrics and what was promised in the contract. This could affect our reconciliation and the bonus structure for the quarter. I don’t want to escalate to legal without first discussing it with you directly.

Could you please call me today when you have a moment? There’s no formal deadline in writing, but the finance team is preparing documents for the board and we need to understand the situation before they finalize numbers. I appreciate your prompt attention.

Thanks,

body:
Hey Maya,

Hope you’re well. I’m planning to swing by Friday with the books for our swap, and I’ll drop them on your porch while you’re at work—no need to be home. If anything changes I’ll text, otherwise just leave whatever you want to pass along on your doorstep and I’ll collect it.

No action needed on your part; this is just a heads-up so you know to expect a small package. Looking forward to catching up next week over coffee if our schedules align.

Warmly,
Ava

subject: Serious client concern — please contact immediately
body:
Hello Marco,

I just had a lengthy call with one of our largest clients who expressed severe dissatisfaction with the latest deliverable and hinted at moving their account if we don’t resolve this to their satisfaction. They did not set a deadline, but the tone and context make it clear they expect senior-level engagement promptly.

Can you call the client this afternoon to hear their issues and propose corrective steps? I’ll join the call if you’d like, but we need to address this head-on to preserve the relationship. Please confirm when you can reach them.

Regards,
Jennifer

body:
Hi Noah,

Thanks for ordering the birthday cookies. I’ll deliver the box by Friday during business hours unless you prefer a different time. I won’t need you to be home — I can leave them on your porch if that’s easiest.

This email is just to confirm delivery preference; no action is required if Friday works. If you need a different day, reply with an alternative and I’ll try to accommodate. I hope the cookies add something sweet to the celebration!

Best,

subject: Unusual activity detected on your account — action required
body:
Hello Maria,

We detected multiple sign-in attempts and an unusual wire transfer attempt from your checking account last night. For your protection we have temporarily limited outgoing transfers. To restore full access and to confirm whether these transactions were authorized, please log in to our secure portal and complete the identity verification within the next 12 hours.

If you did not initiate these transactions, call our 24/7 fraud line immediately at 1-800-555-0199. We are holding further outbound activity until we hear from you.

Fraud Prevention Team

body:
Dear Mr. Thompson,

Your recent bloodwork shows an elevated potassium level that requires prompt review. This result can be associated with medication interactions or kidney function changes and should not be ignored. Please contact our nurse triage line today so a clinician can review your medications and symptoms with you; if you are experiencing dizziness, chest discomfort, or shortness of breath, go to the ER immediately.

Call us at (555) 333-2244 between 8am and 6pm. If you cannot reach us, present to urgent care and bring this email.

Best regards,
City Clinic Laboratory

Please reply with “ACCEPT” to keep the new itinerary, or call our reservations desk at 1-888-222-9000 to discuss alternatives.

Blue Airlines Reservations

Best,
River Park Association

body:
Hey Jenna,

Stop whatever you're doing — the ficus in the lobby has decided to dramatically shed every leaf it owned. I'm forwarding a series of extremely serious photographs and think we may need to convene a botanical emergency response team. Clearly this is the end times for office greenery.

In all seriousness, if you want me to water it or move it away from the heater, I can do that later today. No actual crisis; just wanted to make you grin.

Cheers,
Tom

body:
Hello Shopper,

URGENT SALE: For a very limited period we have slashed prices across our entire inventory. This is a marketing promotion and the 'urgent' label is meant to highlight the special offer window. Visit our site to browse deeply discounted items and use promo code FLASH90 at checkout. Stock is limited and discounts may end without notice.

This email is promotional. If you prefer not to receive such offers, use the unsubscribe link below.

subject: Can you finalize the mockups before I fly out Thursday?
body:
Hi Leo,

Thanks again for the initial mockups. I need the updated versions incorporating the revised color palette and assets before I fly out on Thursday morning so I can present them to the stakeholders while abroad. If you can send the files by Wednesday evening, I will be able to include them in the slide deck.

If that timeline is unrealistic, please tell me today so I can reassign internal tasks or reschedule the presentation. Your work is essential for the next steps.

Best,
Rachel

body:
Alex,

I've read the latest deliverable and I'm frustrated. We agreed on a higher standard, and the persistent formatting errors and missing sections are unacceptable. This has put our team in an awkward spot in front of senior management.

I expect a corrected version, but I am not asking for an immediate emergency fix—just an acknowledgment of the issues and a plan for how you intend to address them in the next revision. Let's avoid future disappointments; quality matters.

Regards,
Mark Rivers

subject: Please call me — client is very upset
body:
Hi Jordan,

I just got off the phone with a long-time client who is very upset about the recent data discrepancy. They want to speak with someone from our team about restitution and next steps. There's no formal deadline spelled out, but this is high-stakes: their continued business and a pending renewal are at risk unless we respond promptly.

Please call me as soon as you see this so we can coordinate the client call and agree on proposed remedies before they escalate further.

Thanks,
Samantha

No action required on your part unless you prefer a different day or time—just wanted to let you know what to expect.

Warmly,
Erin

Launch Coordinator

body:

If you experience severe symptoms such as shortness of breath or swelling, seek immediate care.

Sincerely,
Dr. Lena Park
Northside Clinic

I waited over an hour despite having an appointment, the representative was dismissive, and my issue remains unresolved. This level of service is unacceptable from an organization that prides itself on customer care. I expect someone to acknowledge this and tell me what steps you'll take to correct it; I'm not asking for an immediate fix, just a clear plan. Please respond when convenient.

Regards,

Book Club Organizer

Managing Editor

body:
Hello,

I am writing because the recent consultation did not resolve the issues we discussed and, frankly, I am disappointed in the lack of follow-through. I waited two weeks for a promised update that never arrived, and when I reached out I received only a vague response. While I am upset and wanted to express that, I am not demanding immediate emergency action — simply a clear explanation and a plan to move forward. Please respond with next steps when you have a moment.

Regards,
Jaya Patel

body:

This matter could have significant consequences for several accounts, so we need your insights to determine the appropriate remediation and communication strategy. Thank you,
Marianne Cole
VP, Compliance

subject: We need to talk about the account — please call me
body:
Hi Priya,

This has started to impact our internal reporting and senior leadership is asking questions. I need to discuss next steps and a remediation plan; could you call me as soon as you read this? I’m available this afternoon and would like to get this sorted before it escalates further.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll assume you’re unavailable and will escalate within our organization.

Thanks,
James Cole
Enterprise Client Success

subject: Catching up — I’ll stop by Friday
body:
Hey Anna,

Just checking in to see how you’re doing. I’ll stop by Friday to drop off that book I borrowed last month. No pressure — if you’re busy feel free to text me a good time and I can swing by another day. Also wanted to hear about your trip if you have time for coffee next week.

Hope all is well. Looking forward to catching up whenever it works for you.

Love,
Maya

body:
Hi,

Alert! Our clearance section has been updated with final markdowns on seasonal items. This is a promotional notice to highlight reduced prices on overstocked products. Quantities vary by SKU and sizes/colors may be limited. Visit the clearance page to see what’s left.

This message is intended to drive purchases and is not a time-sensitive service notice. To stop receiving updates, adjust your marketing preferences at the link below.

Cheers,
Bargain Bazaar

subject: Final edits for your piece before publication
body:
Dear Casey,

We’re finalizing the layout for the upcoming issue and need any last copy edits for your essay before it goes to press. If we don’t receive the updated draft the editors will proceed with minor edits to meet the print schedule. Please attach your corrected version in reply so we can incorporate it.

If there are substantial changes you want to request, please note them clearly and we’ll discuss. Otherwise small punctuation and formatting corrections are fine.

Warmly,
Aisha Patel
Editor-in-Chief

subject: Reminder: I'll see you by Wednesday for our session
body:
Hey team,

Quick note to say I’ll see you by Wednesday for our outdoor bootcamp session if the weather holds. I’m not assigning slots or tracking attendance — just letting folks know my plan. Bring water, a towel, and layers. If you can’t make it, no worries; we’ll catch you at the next session.

Looking forward to getting a sweat together. Reply here if you want to carpool or meet earlier.

Cheers,
Mark

subject: Immediate action required: Unusual sign-in detected
body:
Hello Maria,

Our systems detected an unusual sign-in to your AcmeCorp account from a new device and location at 03:12 UTC. For your safety, we have temporarily blocked access to sensitive features. Please follow the secure link below to verify your identity and reset your password within the next 24 hours to avoid account suspension. If you did not attempt this sign-in, you must complete the verification and then contact our security team immediately so we can investigate potential compromise.

Thank you,
AcmeCorp Security Team

subject: Decision needed today: Launch plan for Friday
body:
Hi Ana,

We’re at the final gate for the Friday launch. The marketing spend and go/no-go decision require your sign-off today by 6pm so we can confirm media buys and feature flags. The engineering team can hold deployments until you confirm, but they’ll need time to rollback or address any late issues. If you want changes to the campaign creative, I’ll need a clear list before 4pm to get approvals in time. Please reply with your decision or a quick call window if you want to discuss.

Best,
David

subject: Urgent: Abnormal lab result — please call
body:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

This is Dr. Patel from Sunrise Medical. Your recent lab results show an abnormal potassium level that requires prompt follow-up. While this is not definitive of a specific diagnosis, it can indicate an issue that we prefer to address quickly. Please call our nursing line today or tomorrow morning to schedule a phone assessment or in-person visit within 48 hours so we can determine whether medication adjustments or immediate care are needed.

If you are experiencing chest pain, severe weakness, or difficulty breathing, call emergency services first. We look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Dr. Neha Patel

subject: Flight disrupted — alternate routing requires your consent
body:
Hi Jorge,

Delta flight DL762 you booked for Thursday has been cancelled due to mechanical issues. We have two alternate routings that will get you to your destination: one departs the same day with a longer connection and another on Friday morning. We need your selection or permission to rebook on the airline’s choice within the next 6 hours to avoid losing your seat and hotel reimbursement eligibility. If we don’t hear from you, we will tentatively hold the airline’s suggested option but cannot guarantee preferred seating.

Please reply or call the travel desk immediately.

Regards,
Maya — GlobeJet Support

subject: Potential fraud alert on wire transfer — action required
body:
Good afternoon Mr. Thompson,

We detected a $12,500 outbound wire to an unfamiliar beneficiary yesterday evening flagged as unusual activity on your account. For your protection, we’ve put a temporary hold on the transfer. To remove the hold or confirm fraud, please contact our fraud unit within 24 hours at the secure line below. If this was authorized, we will need the transaction confirmation number and the beneficiary phone number to process it. If you cannot reach us, respond to this message to initiate an expedited callback.

Sincerely,
Brookside Bank Fraud Team

subject: Open enrollment: Benefits election due Friday
body:
Hello Priya,

This is a reminder that open enrollment for Novatek benefits closes this Friday at 11:59pm. You need to complete your elections for medical, dental, and flexible spending accounts if you wish to change coverage for the coming plan year. If you do nothing, your current elections will carry over for medical and dental, but you must actively enroll to use the FSA in 2025. The online portal has step-by-step instructions and FAQs. If you run into issues, HR will hold extended hours Thursday and Friday.

Thanks,
HR Benefits Team

subject: Quick survey for freshmen — due Monday
body:
Hi Taylor,

We’d appreciate two minutes of your time: the Freshman Experience survey helps us plan next semester’s orientation activities. The survey closes on Monday, so please fill it out before then. Your responses are anonymous and will be aggregated for programming decisions. There’s no penalty for not participating, but early responses help us lock venues and catering numbers. If you have any specific accessibility needs you want addressed at orientation, please mention them in the comment box.

Regards,
Student Life

subject: Sign-ups for park clean-up shifts — deadline next Thursday
body:
Hello Sam,

Thank you for offering to help with the neighborhood park clean-up. We’re finalizing shift assignments next Thursday and would love to include you. Please sign up by then so we can plan tools and team leads. Shifts are morning and afternoon slots; you can indicate preferences on the form. This is a friendly reminder rather than a strict requirement — if something changes, you can still join later but supplies may be limited.

Best,
Elena — Park Friends Volunteer Coordinator

subject: Reminder: Confirm interlibrary loan pickup by next Wednesday
body:
Dear Mr. Rivera,

Your requested interlibrary loan item has arrived and will be held for pickup for one week. Please confirm whether you can pick it up by next Wednesday so we can hold it; otherwise, we will return it to circulation. If you need a different pickup window, reply and we will try to accommodate. This message is a reminder to help with our logistics rather than an emergency — we just want to ensure the book doesn’t get returned before you collect it.

Thank you,
City Library Circulation Desk

subject: Your Thursday briefing: Top stories and market snapshot
body:
Good morning,

Here’s your Thursday briefing with top headlines, market summaries, and a short featured analysis piece. Today’s edition includes a recap of last night’s earnings reports, a market movers list, and two recommended reads. No action is required — this is an informational digest curated to save you time. If you prefer a different delivery frequency, update your preferences at the bottom of the newsletter. Thanks for reading, and let us know if there are topics you’d like covered in future issues.

Warmly,
The Morning Brief team

subject: Your order has shipped — tracking available
body:
Hi Jordan,

Good news — your order #45219 has shipped and is on its way. You can track the package using the link below; the estimated delivery window is between Tuesday and Thursday next week. If you need to change the delivery address or request a hold, please visit the carrier’s portal within the next 48 hours. This is an automated shipping notice for your records. We hope you enjoy your purchase and appreciate your business.

Cheers,
Boxed & Co Orders

subject: Weekly performance dashboard — no action required
body:
Hi Team,

Attached is this week’s automated performance dashboard for the product team. It includes user engagement metrics, retention cohorts, and a short notes section called Highlights. This email is intended to keep you informed; no decisions are required now. If you spot anything that looks off, flag it in the comments on the dashboard and we’ll investigate during our regular Tuesday sync. Thanks for reviewing at your convenience.

Best regards,
Workflows Analytics

subject: Thank you for registering — Greenroom Lecture Series
body:
Hello Samir,

Thanks for registering for the Greenroom lecture on urban design next month. This confirms your spot; seating is general admission. We’ll send a reminder and directions a week before the event, along with info about on-site parking and accessibility. If your plans change and you can’t attend, please let us know so we can release your ticket to the waitlist. We’re excited to have you join us and hope you find the talk valuable.

Warmly,
Nora — Events Coordinator

subject: Brunch next weekend? catching up is long overdue
body:
Hey Sam,

It was so great seeing your photos from the hiking trip. I’m back in town next weekend and thought it would be nice to catch up over brunch — no pressure, just an idea. I’m free Saturday morning but happy to pivot if another time works better for you. If you’re busy, we can always plan something later in the month. Thought I’d reach out and say hello.

Love,
Jen

subject: We miss you — special offer inside
body:
Hi,

We noticed you haven’t streamed in a while and wanted to share a curated selection of new releases we think you’ll enjoy. If you’d like, we can hold a promotional discount on your account for the next billing cycle. This is an optional offer — no action is required unless you’d like to accept the promotion. To opt in, click the button in the app or visit your account page. We hope to see you back on StreamFlix soon.

Best,
The StreamFlix Team

subject: You have a new match — say hello!
body:
Hi Lauren,

You matched with someone new based on your shared interests in cooking and trail running. You can view their profile and send a message directly through the app. This notification is just to let you know; there’s no obligation to respond. If you need help with your profile or want tips for an icebreaker, we’ve included a few sample messages in-app. Have fun and stay safe while meeting new people.

Cheers,
MatchConnect

subject: URGENT: The coffee supply crisis of 2026
body:
Hey everyone,

URGENT: The communal coffee stash has dwindled to emergency levels — I mean, catastrophic. If you enjoy functioning brain cells or the illusion of productivity, please consider replenishing before morale collapses completely. I jest, but seriously, if one of you could pick up a can on your way in tomorrow that would be spectacular. No formal meeting will be scheduled to address this, but the kitchen karma may depend on you. My sincere gratitude (and eternal indebtedness) to whoever rescues us from decaf purgatory.

Thanks,
Mark

subject: Thesis advising slots for spring — sign up soon
body:
Dear Kelsey,

I’m opening advising slots for spring thesis supervision. There are only a handful of meeting times left before registration, and I’ll be assigning students on a first-come, first-served basis to ensure supervision capacity. Please send me a brief statement of your thesis topic and preferred meeting days as soon as you can so I can reserve a slot. I can’t promise availability if you wait until registration week because my schedule fills quickly. If you cannot commit now, let me know and we can discuss alternatives.

Best regards,
Prof. Andrew Lang

subject: Feedback on clause edits before publication
body:
Hi Omar,

We’re preparing the client-facing policy document for publication and I’d like your input on the confidentiality clause and data retention section. The production team plans to publish this version imminently, so if you have any substantive edits or objections please send them back today so we can incorporate them. If no response is received, we will assume assent and proceed. I don’t want to surprise you with changes post-publication, so a quick confirmation or brief redlined notes would be very helpful.

Regards,
Ruth

subject: Noise complaint — this is getting old
body:
Hello,

I’m writing because the loud music and stomping from apartment 4B has continued late into the night several times this month. We’ve all been patient, but the constant disturbance is affecting sleep and well-being. I’m not calling in a formal complaint yet, but please be considerate and keep noise down after 10pm. If things don’t improve, I will have no choice but to escalate to building management. I hope you understand this is not personal — just a request to respect shared living spaces.

Sincerely,
Ana Delgado

subject: URGENT SALE — Prices slashed for 48 hours only!
body:
Hello Shopper,

Hurry! Our URGENT SALE is live — for 48 hours only we’ve slashed prices across electronics and home goods. Supplies are limited and this is a one-time promotional event. Click through to view curated bundles and apply the promo code at checkout. This is a marketing message to encourage a purchase; there’s no account action required beyond choosing to shop. If you don’t want marketing emails like this, manage your preferences via the unsubscribe link.

Best deals,
FlashDeals Team

subject: Immediate action required: Limited-time offers just for you
body:
Hi Ava,

Immediate action required! (Well, only if you want the discount.) We’ve reserved special clearance prices on select furniture for you. These offers are time-limited and inventory moves fast, so check the curated list if you’re interested. This is a promotional email using urgency language to increase conversions — there is no account risk or real-world deadline. If you’re not shopping now, ignore this message or click unsubscribe to stop similar notices.

Regards,
HomeClearance Promotions

subject: We need to talk about last week’s campaign
body:
Hi Marco,

I wanted to express serious concern about the results of last week’s digital campaign. Several clients noticed incorrect targeting and the PR team has started asking questions. This has potential reputational implications and may affect our contract renewal conversations if we don’t address it. I’d appreciate a phone call today to walk through what happened and what steps you recommend for remediation. There isn’t a formal deadline in writing, but the conversation needs to happen promptly so we can prepare a response for the client meeting next week.

Thanks,
Samantha

subject: Potential compliance exception identified — please call
body:
Hello Priya,

During a routine review, we flagged a contract clause that may be out of alignment with our updated regulatory guidance. I don’t have the authority to resolve this alone — we need your interpretation and a decision on whether to pursue an amendment. This could escalate to audit findings if unaddressed, so please call the compliance office today at your earliest convenience to discuss the implications and next steps. There is no written deadline, but timely action will reduce the risk of formal notices.

Regards,
Compliance Team

subject: I'll stop by Friday with the pie
body:
Hi Joe,

Hope you and the kids are doing well. I’ll stop by Friday with that key lime pie I promised and we can catch up for a bit on the porch if you’re home. No need to rearrange your schedule — if Friday doesn’t work, just text me another evening and we’ll figure something out. Looking forward to a relaxed visit and swapping some plant-cutting tips. Say hi to Maria and the little ones for me.

Warmly,
Laura

subject: Immediate action required: Multi-factor enrollment failed
body:
Hi Jordan,

Our logs show repeated failed attempts to enroll your account in the new multi-factor authentication system. Because these attempts look suspicious, we've temporarily restricted access to your email and VPN. To restore full access, please complete the identity verification steps at the portal linked below within 4 hours so we can verify the activity and re-enable your account.

If you do not complete verification in that window we will escalate to account lock and you will need to contact support during business hours to regain access. If you didn't attempt to enroll, reply immediately so we can prioritize an incident review.

Thanks,
IT Security Team

subject: Decision needed today on settlement offer
body:
Good morning,

We received a revised settlement offer from opposing counsel late last night. The terms include a confidentiality clause and a non-compete for 12 months. They have requested acceptance by end of business today to avoid re-opening negotiations. Given the financial and reputational implications, we need your instructions on whether to accept as-is, request modifications, or reject.

Please call me as soon as possible (my direct line is below) so I can advise on likely outcomes and file the response. If I don't hear from you by 5:00 PM I will proceed with our recommended counterproposal.

Best regards,
Emily Park
Partner, Legal Partners

subject: Tax form issue: confirm your SSN for payroll processing
body:
Hi Marcus,

During final payroll processing for this pay period we detected a mismatch in the SSN associated with your personnel record and the IRS verification file. This prevents us from finalizing withholdings. HR requires confirmation of your SSN format by noon tomorrow to ensure your next paycheck is processed correctly.

Please reply to this email attaching a photo of your SSN card or a recent pay stub showing the number, or call HR to verify over the phone. If we don't receive confirmation in time, tax withholdings may be applied under backup withholding rules and corrections will be delayed.

Regards,
Payroll Department

subject: Urgent: pre-op clearance needed before Friday
body:
Hello Sam,

Your surgery is scheduled for this Friday morning, and our pre-operative review shows missing clearance for a recent cardiac consultation and updated labs. The surgical team has asked that we receive these documents no later than Thursday afternoon so they can review them at the pre-op meeting. Without them, the procedure may need to be postponed.

Please upload the cardiology report and bloodwork results through the patient portal today, or call our office to arrange same-day fax if you cannot access the portal. If you have questions about what's needed, contact my nurse, Linda, at the number below.

Sincerely,
Dr. Ana Ruiz

subject: Security alert: suspicious wire transfer pending approval
body:
Dear Ms. Patel,

A high-value wire transfer from your business account ($47,500) is currently queued and flagged by our fraud detection system due to account behavior anomalies. We have placed the transfer on hold until we receive confirmation from you. To release the funds, please confirm the transaction details and approve via the secure link below within 2 hours.

If you did not authorize this transfer, DO NOT use the link — call our fraud line immediately at the number listed on the back of your card so we can freeze activity. We will not process the request without your explicit confirmation.

Thank you,
Fraud & Compliance Team

subject: Survey: Fall housing preferences — respond by next Tuesday
body:
Hi Alex,

We're collecting preferences for fall semester housing to help with roommate matching and assignment planning. The short survey should take about five minutes and asks about your preferred building, quiet floor preference, and whether you'd like a single or shared room. Please submit your responses by next Tuesday so our housing office can begin drafting the first pass of assignments.

This is not binding — you'll have opportunities to make changes during move-in week — but completing it early helps us accommodate specific needs. If you have questions, reply to this email or stop by the Student Affairs desk.

Warmly,
Student Affairs

subject: Open Enrollment form due Friday
body:
Hello Taylor,

Open enrollment for health and commuter benefits closes this Friday. Benefits Team
