Kind regards,
TechForward Program Team

subject: Background check form — please complete by Monday
body:

If you have any concerns about the information requested or need a paper form, reply and we'll make accommodations. We appreciate your time and look forward to seeing you at the event.

Sasha
Volunteer Coordinator

Netflix

body:

Sincerely,
CareConnect Notifications

body:
Hello patrons,

No registration is required for casual visits, but some special events have limited seating and sign-up links are provided. We hope to see you at the library soon.

Warmly,
Maple Branch Library

subject: Your invoice for August is ready
body:

If you prefer manual payment or have questions about any line items, log in to your account and contact support through the billing portal. We're happy to help clarify any details.

Thanks,
Stripe Billing

If you'd like to propose an item for the next agenda, reply to the board email or attend the upcoming monthly meeting. The next meeting is listed on the calendar; attendance is welcome but not required.

Best,
Oakridge HOA Board Secretary

subject: OMG this is URGENT (not) — movie night?
body:
Hey—

Emergency update: the new superhero movie is out and my couch is threatened by lack of popcorn. I can't possibly live without your attendance tonight at 8:00 PM, so please RSVP immediately or I'll survive but with dramatic sighing. Seriously though, swing by if you're free; we'll order pizza and see how long we can last through the loudest action scenes.

No pressure at all. If you can't make it, we'll catch the next one, I promise. Text me if you're coming.

Cheers,
Sam

subject: Need final feedback before we publish the page
body:
Hi Miguel,

Thanks for the copy you provided — it's looking good. We are scheduled to push the new product landing page live with the marketing campaign this coming morning, and the designer needs your final microcopy edits to ensure button labels and disclaimers match. If we don't receive your changes before the end of tonight's build window the original placeholder text will be used.

Can you please review the attached and send any edits or an approval as soon as possible? If you need more time, tell me which sections you want us to hold back.

Best,
Rachel

subject: Wardrobe fit required before dress rehearsal
body:
Hi Elena,

We're finalizing costumes for the Spring showcase. We have you listed for a quick wardrobe fit slot tomorrow afternoon between rehearsals; the tailor will be at the theater and needs to take measurements and note any alterations. If you don't come by, we may have to alter a standard piece rather than tailoring specifically to you, which could affect comfort on show night.

Please reply to confirm you can stop in tomorrow during your break or let us know an alternate time today so we can keep the schedule tight.

Thanks,
Tomas

subject: Seriously? Still waiting on my invoice payment
body:

I've been chasing the overdue invoice from May for three weeks now and your silence is getting frustrating. I delivered the final artwork on time and submitted the invoice as agreed. I need confirmation that payment was processed or a clear schedule for when it will be paid. This continued delay is creating cashflow problems on my end.

Please respond by tomorrow with either proof of payment or a definite date. If there are issues with the deliverable, tell me specifically so we can resolve them instead of broad promises.

Regards,
Claire Hawkins

subject: URGENT SALE: Everything must go! Limited stock!
body:
Hello Shopper,

Don't miss our URGENT SALE — markdowns on home goods, apparel, and gadgets through this weekend. Stock is limited and prices are tempting. Add items to your cart and use code FLASH20 at checkout for an extra discount. This is a promotional push to clear seasonal items and is valid while supplies last.

subject: We need to talk about last quarter's deliverables
body:

Several of our stakeholders reported that the Q2 reports lacked certain supporting data and the presentation we received didn't reflect agreed-upon metrics. This is starting to erode confidence, and the client has asked for an explanation at the upcoming review.

Can you schedule a call this week so we can prepare a consolidated response and, if necessary, propose remediation steps? It's important we align on the details and present a clear plan to the client.

Thanks,
Amanda

subject: Big opportunity: feature in national campaign (please read)
body:
Hi there,

Congrats — your brand has been shortlisted for inclusion in a national summer campaign. This exposure could be significant for reach and sales. To be considered, we need your media kit and logo files; while we don't have a formal deadline, campaign selection will occur in the coming weeks and teams are already moving fast.

If you're interested, reply with the assets attached and a brief note about preferred messaging. If not, no worries — just let us know and we'll remove you from consideration.

Best regards,
Marketing Team

subject: I'll stop by Friday with the plant
body:
Hey Ben,

Just a heads up — I'll stop by Friday to drop off the philodendron I mentioned. No need to do anything on your end, I can set it by the back door if you're not home. Also, congrats on the new job! Can't wait to hear how your first week goes.

If Friday doesn't work for you, tell me another day next week and I'll swing by then instead. See you soon.

Love,
Mia

subject: Weekly summary: you hit 75% of your goals
body:

Nice work this week — you completed 75% of your scheduled workouts and increased your average daily steps. We've generated a personalized plan suggestions section to help you get back to 100% next week, including two quick strength routines and a hydration reminder.

No action required; open the app to view details and accept any suggested program adjustments. Keep going — small changes add up.

Cheers,
FitTracker Team

subject: Super urgent: coffee crisis averted (not really)

If you want me to secure a permanent fix I can add the repair to the maintenance ticket, but for now our caffeine levels will hold. No actual emergency, just dramatic commentary from yours truly.

Best,
Mike

subject: Refund eligibility review — documentation needed
body:
Hello Priet,

We've started a review for your recent complaint about the damaged appliance. To determine eligibility for a refund or replacement, we need photos of the damage and your order confirmation within the next 48 hours. If we do not receive these items soon, the case will be set to close under standard returns policy and you may need to open a new claim.

Regards,

Please take steps to prevent this noise; if it continues we will need to involve the building manager or consider filing a complaint.

I prefer we handle this neighbor-to-neighbor. Let me know what you plan to do so we can avoid escalation.

Sincerely,
Flash Fitness Sales

subject: We need to discuss the pipeline status
body:

Sophia

subject: Your itinerary - eTicket 483-554-209
body:
Dear Alex,

This is a confirmation of your itinerary for the upcoming trip. Flight SKR 218 departs on Tuesday at 08:20 AM from JFK, arriving at ORD at 10:05 AM. Your seat assignment is 12A; you can request a different seat or add baggage via Manage Booking. Check-in opens 24 hours before departure. If you need to change or cancel your flight, please do so through the website to see available fares and change fees. We look forward to seeing you on board.

Safe travels,
Skyrun Customer Care

subject: URGENT SALE: Last chance to save 90% (limited stock!)
body:
Hello Shopper,

Our URGENT SALE event is live — prices slashed across thousands of items. Inventory is limited and items are moving fast. This is a marketing-only notice reminding you of deeply discounted electronics, home goods, and apparel. Click the link to browse deals and apply code FLASH90 at checkout. This promotional event runs until supplies are depleted and may reappear later. There’s nothing you must do immediately unless you want the deal; consider this a heads-up rather than a time-sensitive security message.

Best,
ShopMaxx Promotions

subject: Speaker bio and slide deck due in three days
body:
Hi Dr. Alvarez,

Thanks again for agreeing to speak at the TechForward symposium. Could you please upload your speaker bio, headshot, and slide deck to the speaker portal within the next three days? We need these items to prepare the event program and the AV team’s run sheet. If you cannot meet that timeline, let us know your constraints and we’ll try to accommodate, but the sooner we have materials the better for promotion and rehearsal scheduling. Thank you for your help.

Warm regards,
Conference Team

subject: Weekly summary: activity streak and suggested workouts
body:
Hi Dana,

Great job keeping your activity streak! This week you completed 4 workouts totaling 3 hours. Based on your progress, we’ve suggested three recovery and strength sessions to balance your routine. There’s a short mobility routine you can try today — estimated time 15 minutes. These are suggestions to help you meet your goals; no action is required unless you want to add them to your calendar or share with a trainer.

Keep it up,
The FitLife Team

subject: We need to talk — serious concerns about last month’s deliverables
body:
Hi Priya,

I’ve reviewed the deliverables from last month and there are several important discrepancies that have put our internal program timeline at risk. The board has asked for clarification, and I’m very concerned about the implications for our continued funding. I’d like to schedule a call to go over the issues and understand what happened and how we’ll resolve it. There’s no formal deadline in writing, but this is high-stakes for our relationship — please call me today or tomorrow so we can address the situation before it escalates.

Regards,
Michael Greene

subject: Top reads for you this week
body:
Hi Taylor,

We curated articles we think you’ll enjoy based on your reading history: long-form essays on design, a profile on a climate researcher, and a practical guide to remote collaboration. This is a personalized digest; no action is required beyond clicking any article that interests you. You can manage your topics or unsubscribe anytime via the link at the bottom of the email. Enjoy the reading list and let us know if you'd like more pieces on specific subjects.

Best,
The Medium Team

subject: I’ll stop by by Friday to pick up the plants
body:
Hey Laura,

Thanks for offering those lavender starts — I’ll stop by by Friday to pick them up. I can be flexible on timing in the afternoon; text me a one-hour window when you’ll be home and I’ll swing by. No rush on your end, and if Friday doesn’t work for you, let me know what other day works best. Looking forward to them; my balcony has been calling for some color.

Cheers,
Samir

subject: Please confirm group presentation roles before tomorrow’s lab
body:
Dear Students,

For the group presentation during tomorrow’s lab session, I need each group to confirm who will present which section so I can finalize the lab schedule. If your group doesn’t respond before class, I’ll assign roles for you, which might not match your preferences. Please email me the roster and sections for your group by tonight so I can publish the revised agenda. This isn’t a formal penalty, but it will affect how the class flows if left unresolved.

Best,
Prof. Daniels

subject: We need a 15-minute call — urgent client escalation
body:
Hi Omar,

I’m reaching out because our client sent a strongly worded note about last week’s deliverable, and they’re threatening to pause the campaign. They expect a senior-level response to explain next steps. There’s no specific written deadline from them, but this is urgent for account health and retention. Can you please call me for 15 minutes today so we can craft the reply and propose corrective measures? If you can’t, tell me whom I should contact on the team to handle it at once.

Thanks,
Claire

subject: Your monthly statement is ready
body:
Dear Customer,

Your monthly statement for account ending 0423 is now available online. This statement includes transactions, balances, and any fees charged during the statement period. Review it at your convenience through our secure portal. If you notice any unfamiliar transactions, contact our customer service within 30 days so we can investigate. If everything looks correct, no action is needed.

Thank you for banking with First Coast,
Customer Service

subject: RSVP for holiday shift by next Wednesday
body:
Hello Jamie,

We’re finalizing volunteer assignments for the holiday meal service next month. If you plan to join a shift, please RSVP via the volunteer portal by next Wednesday so we can allocate enough food and assign roles. Shifts are optional but we do need accurate headcounts for planning. If you cannot commit but might be available last minute, let us know and we’ll add you to the standby list.

Warmly,
Volunteer Coordinator
City Soup Kitchen

subject: This is unacceptable — car left filthy again
body:
Hi Team,

I’m frustrated to report the car was returned covered in mud and more importantly with a broken interior light again. I spent an hour cleaning it this morning before my reservation; this is neither fair nor in line with our cooperative standards. Repeated negligence impacts all members. I expect anyone who borrows the vehicle to return it clean and report damages immediately. If this continues, we’ll need to discuss sanctions at the next meeting.

Regards,
Liam

subject: ATTENTION: Critical markdowns — clearance happening now!
body:
Dear Valued Customer,

Critical markdowns are applied across our summer collection in the clearance event. Prices have been adjusted, and select sizes are available at extreme discounts. This is a promotional email intended to drive sales and should not be interpreted as a service or account alert. Browse our clearance page for final sale items and check the returns policy before purchasing. If something is marked incorrect on the site, please reach out to customer support for clarification.

Sincerely,
Luxury Threads Sales

subject: Reminder: community meeting notes due by Friday (optional)
body:
Hello Everyone,

This is a friendly reminder that if you’d like to contribute meeting notes for last night’s discussion, please send them by Friday. This is optional — we’ll compile what’s sent and share a combined summary for anyone interested. If you don’t have anything to add, there’s no need to respond. We’ll still circulate the final summary regardless, and the board will handle any action items that require votes.

Thanks,
Marcus

subject: You have new matches and messages
body:
Hi Zoe,

You have new matches waiting and a couple of unread messages. Open the app to view profiles and reply to anyone you’d like to continue chatting with. Remember to stay safe when exchanging personal information and consider meeting in public places for first-time meetups. If you want to adjust your notification settings, you can do so from the app.

Best,
The Tinder Team

subject: Immediate Action Required: Suspicious Activity on Your Account
body:
Hello Alex,

We detected multiple failed login attempts and a large wire transfer initiated from your checking account last night. For your protection we have temporarily frozen outgoing transfers pending confirmation. Please reply to this message or call our security line at (800) 555-0199 within the next two hours so we can verify recent activity and lift any holds if transactions are legitimate.

If we do not hear from you within that window we will keep the freeze in place and may cancel pending transfers. We apologize for the inconvenience and are standing by to assist.

Sincerely,
Maya Reynolds
First National Bank Security Team

subject: Decision Required: Scholarship Acceptance by 11:59 PM Tonight
body:
Dear Jordan,

Congratulations again on being selected for the Chancellor's Merit Scholarship. The award requires a formal acceptance to secure funds for the upcoming semester. Our system indicates you have not yet accepted. Please log into your applicant portal and accept the scholarship by 11:59 PM tonight to guarantee the award allocation.

If you need more information or technical assistance with the portal, reply immediately and our office will help. After the deadline we cannot guarantee funds will remain available and may reassign the scholarship.

Best regards,
Tina Morales
Scholarship Coordinator

subject: Urgent: Password Reset Required Within 4 Hours
body:
Hi Priya,

Our security monitoring has flagged your account for abnormal activity. To protect company systems we are requiring an immediate password reset. Please follow the link in the secure portal to change your password within the next four hours. Failure to reset will result in temporary suspension of access to email and internal resources until we verify your credentials.

If you did not initiate any unusual activity, reply to this email and include a reachable phone number; we will call to assist. Thank you for your prompt attention to keep your account secure.

Thanks,
Evan Cho
IT Helpdesk

subject: Flight Change Requires Confirmation Before 6 PM Today
body:
Hello Sam,

Delta has rebooked your outbound flight and placed you on a new itinerary with an earlier connection. The carrier needs confirmation to hold your seat. Please reply to this email or click the confirmation link in your travel portal before 6 PM today so we can accept the change on your behalf.

If we don't receive confirmation by the deadline, the carrier may release the seat or rearrange seating and we cannot guarantee the preferred connection. If you want us to explore alternative routing, let us know immediately.

Safe travels,
Leah Winters
Corporate Travel Coordinator

subject: Approve Q3 Marketing Budget Today
body:
Hi Dana,

We need your sign-off on the revised Q3 marketing budget before we can proceed with vendor commitments. The finance team has a cutoff for procurement at close of business today; without your approval they will not release funds and several vendor contracts will be delayed. I attached a short summary and highlighted the line items that changed.

Could you please review and reply with your approval or any requested edits by 5 PM? If you'd prefer a quick call to walk through the changes, I can be available this afternoon.

Thanks,
Marcus

subject: Student Feedback Survey Due Friday
body:
Hello Taylor,

We hope your semester is going well. As part of our continuous improvement efforts, we ask all students to complete a short course feedback survey. The survey closes this Friday at midnight and should take approximately five minutes to complete. Your responses help shape course offerings and campus services.

This is voluntary but much appreciated; aggregated results will be shared next month. If you already completed it, thank you. Otherwise please take a moment before Friday to submit your feedback via the link below.

Warmly,
Leah Carter
Campus Life Office

subject: Please Complete Benefits Enrollment Form by Next Monday
body:
Hi Morgan,

Open enrollment for voluntary benefits is now live. To ensure your selections take effect for the next plan year, please complete the online benefits enrollment form by next Monday. The form allows you to elect optional dental, vision, and supplemental life coverage.

If you miss the deadline you can only make changes during qualifying events later in the year. HR will host two info sessions this week if you want to review plan details; times are listed in the link below.

Best,
Avery Kim
HR Benefits

subject: Speaker RSVP and Headshot Needed by July 10
body:
Hello Dr. Singh,

Thank you again for agreeing to speak at the Tech Forward Conference. To finalize the program we need your confirmation and a high-resolution headshot by July 10. The production team cannot print materials until we receive both items, and late submissions may not be included in the printed schedule.

If you have any constraints about talk time or AV needs, please let us know when you reply. We appreciate your contribution and look forward to featuring your session.

Regards,
Camila Ortiz
Program Coordinator

subject: Reminder: Overdue Notice and Payment Form
body:
Hi Jordan,

Our records show a small outstanding charge from a borrowed item. While this is not an emergency, clearing the charge prevents holds on future checkouts. Please complete the online payment form by the end of next week to update your account. The fine amount and a link to pay are in your account page.

If you believe this is in error, reply with details and we will review. Otherwise you can also visit the desk during open hours to pay in person.

Thanks,
Library Accounts Team

subject: Today's Top Stories and Weather
body:
Good morning Alex,

Here are the highlights for today: the city council passed a new zoning update, the downtown farmers market returns this weekend, and temperatures will stay in the mid 80s through the week. We also have a feature on a local artist and a roundup of weekend events.

No action required; this is just your daily digest to stay informed. If you prefer a different city section or want to unsubscribe from the morning brief, click the preferences link at the bottom.

Best,
City News Daily Team

subject: Your Order #45217 Has Shipped
body:
Hi Maya,

Good news — your order #45217 has shipped and is on its way. The package is expected to arrive in 3-5 business days. You can track the shipment using the tracking number in your account, and the carrier may attempt delivery during business hours.

If you need to change the delivery address or request hold instructions, click the tracking link or contact our support team. This is an automated notification; no reply to this email is monitored.

Thank you for shopping with ShopEase,
Customer Care

subject: Weekly Performance Report — Marketing Campaigns
body:
Hi Team,

Attached is the automated weekly report summarizing impressions, click-through rates, and conversion trends across our active campaigns. This email is for your information; no immediate action is required unless you notice anomalies. We've highlighted a few unusual dips and peaks and included suggested next steps for Q3 planning.

If you want a deeper drill-down on any metric, reply with the campaign name and timeframe and the analytics team will run a custom query.

Regards,
Optimize Analytics

subject: Your Monthly Plan Renewal Reminder
body:
Hello Chris,

This is a friendly reminder that your Streamline subscription will renew automatically at the start of the next billing cycle. Your account will be charged the usual monthly fee and access will continue uninterrupted. If you wish to change or cancel your plan, please visit your account settings; changes made now will apply to the next billing period.

This message is informational only. No action is required if you want to keep your current subscription.

Thanks,
Streamline Billing Team

subject: Block Party Recap and Photos
body:
Hi Everyone,

Thanks to everyone who came out for Saturday's block party. We had a great turnout, and a few neighbors contributed photos which we've uploaded to the community gallery. This email includes a link to the gallery and a short recap of the volunteer clean-up schedule for next month.

No response needed; just wanted to share highlights and a big thank you to volunteers. If you'd like to help plan the next event, reply and we'll add you to the committee list.

Warmly,
Sara Nguyen
Elm Street Neighborhood Watch

subject: You Have New Matches This Week
body:
Hey Riley,

We thought you might like these profiles based on your recent activity. Open the app to view introductions and start a conversation. These matches are suggestions only; nothing happens until you choose to message someone.

This is simply to keep you informed about potential new connections. If you'd rather not receive weekly suggestions, update your preferences in settings.

Cheers,
The MatchPool Team

subject: Your Loyalty Points Statement
body:
Good afternoon Dana,

You currently have 320 loyalty points and are 80 points away from the next reward tier. Points expire after 12 months of inactivity, and this email lists recent point-earning transactions from your account for your records.

No immediate action is required; this is an informational statement. If you'd like ideas on redeeming points or reviewing transactions in detail, reply and we'll provide a quick guide.

Best,
Coffee Club Rewards

subject: Upcoming Appointment Reminder
body:
Hello Jordan,

This is a reminder that you have an appointment scheduled with Dr. Patel for a routine check-up next Tuesday at 10:30 AM. Please arrive 10 minutes early to complete any updated intake forms. If you need to reschedule, you can do so via the patient portal or call our front desk.

This message is informational and automated. No reply to this email will be monitored.

Sincerely,
Pinegrove Clinic

subject: URGENT: Your Throne Is Missing
body:
Hey Alex,

Hope you're surviving without your royal seat. Just a heads up in case the palace staff haven't informed you: the throne has been misplaced again, likely by the cat who thinks velvet is a toy. Major crisis, obviously. If you plan to resume ruling, I suggest sending a search party, or at minimum, brewing a strong cup of tea to cope.

I jest — but do let me know when you want to meet up this weekend. No actual crowns will be provided.

Cheers,
Ben

subject: Unacceptable Noise Last Night
body:
Alex,

I am beyond frustrated after being kept awake until 2 AM by loud music coming from the apartment above. This is not the first time and it's disrespectful to the building's residents. We pay to live in a place with quiet hours, and it's time people start following them. Tolerating this is not an option.

I expect management to enforce the rules and for repeat offenders to be warned. I will escalate further if behavior does not change, but wanted to put you on notice.

Patricia

subject: URGENT SALE: Prices Dropping for 48 Hours Only!
body:
Hello Shopper,

We have an urgent sale you won't want to miss: for the next 48 hours we are slashing prices sitewide. This is a limited time promotional blast to clear inventory, and popular items often sell out quickly. Click through to see daily doorbusters and stackable coupons.

This is a marketing email. No immediate action is required unless you want to purchase; availability is subject to stock. You can opt out of future offers through our preference center at the bottom of the page.

Happy shopping,
FlashDeals Team

subject: Heads Up: Production Code Freeze in Two Hours
body:
Hi Team,

We are implementing a production code freeze in two hours ahead of the service migration tonight. If you have outstanding hotfixes that must be deployed, tag them now and coordinate with on-call so we can triage exceptions. Any uncoordinated pushes after the freeze will be rolled back to preserve stability during migration.

Please confirm on Slack if you have anything critical pending so we can prioritize accordingly. We will post a restart window and monitor health metrics closely during the transition.

Thanks,
Ravi Patel
Build Operations

subject: Concerned About Project Deliverables — Please Call
body:
Hi Jordan,

I need to speak with you about the deliverables from the third-party vendor on our joint client engagement. Several items are incomplete and the client has expressed frustration, mentioning potential escalation to their board. I would like to discuss the status, next steps, and whether we can present a mitigation plan.

Please call me when you have a moment today; I know your schedule is busy, but this needs a prompt human conversation to decide who will contact the client and what we will commit to next.

Regards,
Evelyn

subject: I Might Stop By on Friday
body:
Hi Alex,

Just checking in — it's been a while since we caught up. I might stop by Friday to drop off those gardening tools and say hello if the weather holds. No pressure at all; if you're around and want to chat that's great, otherwise I'll leave them on your porch and we can coordinate another time.

Let me know if Friday works for you, but don't worry if it's inconvenient. Hope everything's well with you and family.

Best,
Mark

subject: Top Secret: Emergency Jello Allocation Meeting
body:
Howdy Alex,

This is an extremely top secret, terribly urgent notice that the annual jello allocation meeting has been scheduled for next Thursday. Attendance is mandatory only if you value the dignity of your stapler. Please come prepared with suggestions for wobble patterns and a brief account of any prior gelatin-related incidents.

We promise this is satire and in no way replaces important company communications. If you're allergic to pranks, feel free to hide in the break room.

Yours in silliness,
The Pranks Committee

subject: FINAL NOTICE: URGENT DEALS ENDING — Claim Now!
body:
Dear Valued Customer,

FINAL NOTICE: URGENT DEALS are still waiting in your cart! Our seasonal clearance has items pushed down to rock-bottom prices and we wanted to alert you before they change. This is a marketing push to drive purchases; inventory levels fluctuate quickly so act if something catches your eye.

If you do not wish to receive promotional emails, you can unsubscribe at any time. This message is purely promotional and requires no response unless you choose to shop.

Warmly,
GlamStore Sales

subject: Unusual activity detected on your account — immediate action required
body:
Hi Maria,

We detected multiple sign-in attempts to your checking account from an unrecognized device and location this morning. For your protection we have temporarily locked online access to your account. To restore full access and review the recent activity, please verify your identity using the secure link below within the next 2 hours. Failure to respond will require an extended verification period and could delay any outgoing payments.

If you did not attempt to sign in, do not reply to this email but use the link or call our support line at the number listed on our website immediately.

Sincerely,
First Federal Bank - Security Team

subject: Decision needed: Approve vendor contract by EOD tomorrow
body:
Hi Alex,

We have the final version of the vendor contract for the Q4 marketing campaign attached. Legal has cleared the terms, but procurement needs your sign-off before we can finalize the onboarding. The vendor is only holding the proposed pricing until close of business tomorrow; without your approval we may lose the discount and have to start the procurement cycle again.

Please review the attached redlines and reply with approval or any last comments by 5 PM tomorrow. If you prefer a quick call, I can make time this afternoon.

Thanks,
Karen

subject: Important: Abnormal lab result requires prompt follow-up
body:
Hello Jordan,

We are writing to inform you that your recent blood test shows an abnormal result that should be discussed with your physician as soon as possible. While the finding is not necessarily an emergency, it can indicate conditions that benefit from timely evaluation and treatment. Please contact Dr. Patel’s office to schedule a follow-up appointment within the next 48 hours so they can review the results and recommend next steps.

If you experience severe symptoms such as shortness of breath, chest pain, or fainting, seek emergency care immediately.

Sincerely,
City Health Lab

subject: Flight cancellation: rebooking options must be selected within 48 hours
body:
Dear Sam,

We regret to inform you that Flight AW237 from Seattle to Denver on August 3 has been canceled due to unforeseen operational constraints. We have temporarily reserved alternative itineraries, but those holds will expire in 48 hours. To retain the rebooking option or request a refund, please log in to your reservation and select your preferred option within two days. If we do not hear from you, we will automatically rebook the next available flight and notify you by email.

We apologize for the inconvenience and are available to assist with any special accommodations.

Best regards,
AirWings Customer Support

subject: Account suspended after detected credential compromise — reset now
body:
Hi Priya,

Our monitoring detected that your corporate credentials were used from an unfamiliar IP address and multiple failed login attempts were observed. As a precaution we have suspended access to your account to prevent unauthorized actions. To restore access, you must complete a password reset and multi-factor verification within the next hour so we can confirm it was you. After that window, additional manual review will be required which could delay access for 24–48 hours.

Please follow the secure reset link or call the IT Service Desk for assistance.

Thanks,
IT Service Desk

subject: Course evaluation: please submit by Friday
body:
Dear Student,

As the semester wraps up, our department asks that you complete the anonymous course evaluation for HIST 210 by this Friday. Your feedback helps instructors improve content and classroom experience. The survey takes approximately five minutes and is hosted on the student portal.

While your responses are anonymous and not tied to grades, timely completion ensures your voice is included in end-of-term summaries. If you have any trouble accessing the evaluation, reply to this email and we’ll help you.

Thank you for taking the time.

Best,
Office of the Registrar

subject: Open enrollment form due by end of month
body:
Hi Emma,

Open enrollment for next year’s benefits ends at midnight on the last day of this month. If you want to make changes to your health plan, add dependents, or enroll in the flexible spending account, please complete the online form before the deadline. If you do nothing, your current elections will carry over in most cases, except for certain plans that require active re-enrollment.

You can access the portal via the link below; HR drop-in hours are available this Wednesday if you’d like assistance.

Sincerely,
Benefits Team

subject: RSVP for team lunch by Thursday
body:
Hi Team,

We’re organizing a casual team lunch next Wednesday to welcome the new hires. Please RSVP by this Thursday so I can confirm numbers with the caterer. If you have any dietary restrictions, include those in your reply; otherwise I’ll assume standard menu preferences. No need for a long note — a simple “Yes” or “No” works fine.

I’ll send a final confirmation of the time and location after I have the headcount.

Thanks,
Lisa

subject: Shift preference form — return by next Monday
body:
Hello Dana,

Thank you for signing up to volunteer at the community festival. To help us assign shifts, please complete the short preference form indicating your available times by next Monday. While we will do our best to honor preferences, assignments are made based on overall coverage needs and first-come availability.

If you cannot complete the form by the deadline, reply to let me know and I’ll try to accommodate you, but late submissions may limit options.

Warm regards,
Maya
Volunteer Coordinator

subject: Your order has shipped — tracking inside
body:
Hi Leo,

Good news — your order #78421 has shipped and is en route. You can track the package using the link below. Estimated delivery is Tuesday between 10 AM and 6 PM. If you need to update the delivery day or provide special instructions for the driver, use the carrier’s tracking page.

This is an automated update; no reply is necessary. If you have any problems with the delivery, contact our support team through the help center.

Thanks for shopping with us,
ShipIt Fulfillment

subject: Open Source Weekly — top projects and news
body:
Hello,

Welcome to this week’s edition of Open Source Weekly. We highlight five projects gaining traction, a tutorial on improving test coverage, and a roundup of community events. There are also links to interviews with maintainers and a featured contributor spotlight.

If you’d like to unsubscribe or change preferences, use the link at the bottom of the newsletter. No action is required to continue receiving these digests.

Enjoy the read,
The Open Source Weekly Team

subject: Monthly expense summary — July
body:
Hi Team,

Attached is the automated monthly expense summary for July. It includes departmental totals, outliers flagged by the system, and a comparison to the prior quarter. This report is for your information and archival purposes; there are no immediate actions required unless you identify discrepancies.

If you find anything that looks incorrect, please open a ticket with our finance team and reference the line item. Otherwise no reply is necessary.

Regards,
Finance Reports

subject: Welcome to Crafty Circle — start exploring
body:
Hi there,

Welcome to Crafty Circle! We’re excited to have you join our community of makers. Here are a few starter guides and popular threads to help you get going. You’ll also find upcoming local meetups listed on the events page.

This is just a friendly onboarding message — no response needed. If you want tailored recommendations, reply with the crafts you’re most interested in.

Warmly,
Crafty Circle Team

subject: Delivery attempt: driver left notice
body:
Hi Owen,

Our driver attempted delivery of your package today but was unable to leave it at your address. A notice has been left with instructions for rescheduling or picking up at the local depot. You can arrange a redelivery on the carrier website or use the pickup reference at the depot within the next five business days.

This is an informational message; if you need help arranging a different delivery window, contact our support team.

Best,
ParcelCourier

subject: Catching up — no plans, just saying hi
body:
Hey Nora,

I was thinking about our college road trip memories and wanted to check in. No agenda here — just hope you’re doing well. If you’re around next month maybe we can grab coffee, but no pressure. Miss our long catch-ups and thought I’d say hi.

Drop me a line when you have a moment; otherwise sending good vibes your way.

Love,
Marta

subject: Appointment reminder: annual wellness check next month
body:
Dear Jonathan,

This is a courtesy reminder that your annual wellness check is scheduled for August 12 at 10:30 AM. The appointment is pre-booked; if this time doesn’t work for you, please call the clinic to reschedule. If you plan to bring records or a medication list, have them available at check-in.

No immediate action is required unless you need to change the time. We look forward to seeing you.

Sincerely,
Willow Family Clinic

subject: Minutes from last week's meeting
body:
Hello Council Members,

Attached are the minutes from last Wednesday’s meeting. They include motions passed, budget updates, and the schedule for upcoming events. Please review them at your convenience; corrections can be submitted to the secretary by email, though there is no immediate deadline.

Thanks to everyone who attended and contributed. Let us know if you have questions at the next meeting.

Best,
Amir
Student Council Secretary

subject: URGENT: The fate of the universe depends on your coffee order
body:
Hey Ben,

Just a quick heads-up: the perilous office coffee situation has reached critical mass. If you don’t bring back a fresh bag of beans tomorrow, the entire marketing department may cease to function and productivity will nosedive into oblivion. I jest, of course, but seriously — if you’re heading to the grocery store could you grab the usual? I’ll happily reimburse you.

Appreciate the heroics in advance. No official deadline beyond the natural lifeline of caffeine.

Cheers,
Colleen

subject: Please confirm final budget numbers before our audit
body:
Hello Priyanka,

We’re preparing for the external audit scheduled for the week after next and need final budget confirmations from all project leads to compile the auditor packet. If you can send the updated expense reconciliation and any pending invoices before the auditors begin their review, it will save us time and reduce follow-up questions. We don’t have a firm hard-stop in the email, but auditors will start reviewing your section early next week, so earlier submission is essential.

Could you please provide those numbers as soon as possible?

Thanks,
Marcus
Grants Office

subject: This is ridiculous — your product failed again
body:
Hello Support,

I am incredibly frustrated. The unit I bought from your company stopped working for the second time in six months. I have spent hours on hold, been promised callbacks that never happened, and still do not have a functional product. This is unacceptable for an item at this price point and your lack of responsiveness is infuriating.

I am writing to vent and to demand that someone finally take responsibility, but I do not expect miracles. Please escalate this if you actually value customers.

Regards,
Caroline

subject: IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED: URGENT SALE ENDS TONIGHT
body:
Hi Shopper,

Don’t miss our urgent sale — prices have been slashed sitewide and the event ends tonight. This is a limited-time promotion and inventory is low, so add items to your cart now to secure the discounts. Click through to see flash deals on electronics, home goods, and apparel. This is an automated marketing message; purchases are optional and there are no account penalties for not participating.

If you prefer not to receive these alerts, update your preferences at the bottom of the email.

Thanks,
MegaDeals Promotions

subject: We need to talk about the Nichols account
body:
Hi Tara,

I’m reaching out because Nichols has escalated concerns about campaign performance and indicated they are reconsidering our relationship. We haven’t received a formal termination notice, but the client expects a call to address several unresolved deliverables and proposed remediation. This is high-stakes for our account team; a careful, timely response could determine whether we retain the client.

Please call me today so we can align on talking points and a proposed recovery plan. I realize this is short notice, but the client’s sentiment is acute and we should act promptly.

Best,
Simon

subject: I'll stop by Friday to drop off the plant you liked
body:
Hi Marcus,

I was doing some potting this weekend and remembered you mentioned liking that variegated pothos. I’ll stop by Friday afternoon to drop off a cutting if that still works for you. If Friday doesn’t suit, no worries — I can bring it next week instead. Just leave the front gate unlocked or drop me a quick note about a better time.

Looking forward to catching up briefly when I’m in the neighborhood.

Warmly,
Rachael

subject: Immediate Action Required: Confirm your interest in exclusive offers
body:
Hi Keisha,

We’re sending you an exclusive set of offers that require immediate action to add selected styles to your reserved list. This message uses urgent language to highlight a marketing reservation window, but there are no penalties for not responding; reserved items simply return to general availability. If you’d like us to hold anything, click the link and confirm your selections. Otherwise you may safely ignore this email.

Thanks for being a subscriber — reply if you want curated picks from a stylist.

Best,
StyleLane Offers

subject: Please finalize artwork before handover on Tuesday
body:
Hi Devin,

We’re on a tight schedule preparing the files for press. The prepress handover to the printer is set for Tuesday morning; anything not finalized prior to that will miss this print run and be pushed to the next batch, delaying distribution. I know you’re handling several pieces, but please prioritize finalizing the full-bleed files and the color proofs so I can package them for handoff.

If you anticipate any blockers, tell me today so we can reassign tasks. Otherwise, please send the final files tonight.

Thanks,
Marta

subject: Immediate action required: Unusual login detected
body:
Hi Alex,

We detected an unusual login to your corporate account from an unfamiliar IP address at 02:14 UTC. For your protection we have temporarily suspended some access. Please verify your identity and reset your password using the secure link below within the next two hours to restore full access. If you do not complete verification within that window, additional authentication steps will be required by our security team.

If you did not attempt this login, contact the security hotline immediately at 1-800-555-SECURE.

Thanks,
IT Security Team

subject: Decision needed today on Q3 budget reallocation
body:
Hi Jordan,

We pushed the revised Q3 budget to the board packet this morning. The finance committee expects a final allocation decision by 5:00 PM today so they can include the updated numbers in the quarterly review. I know we discussed two options — if you approve Option B I can sign off and route it. If you prefer changes, please mark them and send back before 3:30 PM so I can incorporate edits.

Apologies for the rush, but the board meeting is tomorrow and we cannot delay. Please call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Sarah

subject: Pre-op forms missing — surgery tomorrow
body:
Hello Maria,

We are preparing for your knee arthroscopy scheduled for tomorrow at 08:00 AM. Our records show the required pre-operative clearance questionnaire and allergy form are incomplete. Hospital policy requires these forms to be on file at least 12 hours before the procedure. Please complete and upload the two documents using the patient portal link in this email no later than tonight at 8:00 PM to avoid having to postpone your operation.

If you need assistance accessing the portal, call our office and ask for the pre-op coordinator.

Sincerely,
Dr. Anjali Patel, Scheduling

subject: Flight rebooking required — outbound canceled
body:
Dear Mr. Gonzalez,

We regret to inform you that Flight ATL-452 on June 3rd has been canceled due to crew availability. We have provisional seats on a different carrier departing the same day, but the alternate options will only be held for your booking until 11:59 PM tonight. Please log in to the Atlas Travel portal or reply to this email confirming which of the three proposed itineraries you prefer so we can secure your seat. If we do not receive a confirmation before the hold expires, your original reservation will be refunded and you will need to rebook at current fares.

Regards,
Customer Care, Atlas Travel

subject: Verify suspicious transfer of $4,200
body:
Hi Taylor,

Our monitoring flagged a wire transfer of $4,200 leaving your checking account to an external beneficiary late last night. We have placed a temporary hold on the transaction pending your authorization. Please reply to this email or call the number below within 30 minutes to confirm whether you initiated the transfer. If we do not hear from you within that timeframe, we will escalate the investigation and freeze outgoing transactions for 48 hours to protect your funds.

This is an important security action; if you did not authorize this transfer, please call 1-800-555-7243 immediately.

Best,
Midtown Bank Fraud Prevention

subject: Quick student survey — due Friday
body:
Hi Chris,

We are gathering feedback on campus dining this semester and would really appreciate two minutes of your time. The short survey asks about meal plan satisfaction and suggestions for new menu items. Responses help the dining team plan next semester but are not tied to any critical process. The survey will close this Friday at 11:59 PM, after which results will be compiled for the committee.

Please follow the link below to participate. Thanks in advance for your input — it helps shape dining options for everyone.

Warmly,
Student Life Office

subject: Open enrollment selections needed by Friday, June 11
body:
Hello Priya,

Open enrollment for our 401(k) and supplemental benefits is open through Friday, June 11. If you want to make changes to your contribution percentage or enroll in new coverage, please log into the benefits portal and submit your selections before the deadline. No action will result in your current elections rolling over for the next plan year.

This is a routine administrative window and not an emergency, but completing it by the deadline ensures your desired coverage begins on schedule without manual processing delays.

Thanks,
People Operations

subject: Summer newsletter content due next Monday
body:
Hi volunteers,

We're assembling the summer newsletter and would love short updates and photos from each program coordinator. If you have event recaps or upcoming class descriptions to include, please email them to me by next Monday so we can finalize layout. Missing items will be omitted but can appear in the following issue. This request is just to keep our schedule and printing timeline — no one will be penalized for late submissions.

Appreciate your help keeping the newsletter lively.

All the best,
Rene, Communications

subject: Leave a review for 10% off — offer ends Sunday
body:
Hello Dana,

Thank you for your recent purchase from our shop. We'd be grateful if you could leave a short review of your item. As a small thank-you, we are offering a 10% off coupon for your next purchase to anyone who posts a verified review by Sunday. This is a typical promotional deadline to align with our weekend sale planning and does not affect your current order.

If you need a link or assistance leaving a review, reply and we'll provide one.

Cheers,
ShopLocal Customer Care

subject: This Week in Tech: AI tools and regulation
body:
Hello,

Welcome to this week's edition of The Weekly Digest. We've rounded up the top stories in technology including new AI tool launches, pending regulatory hearings, and a feature on accessibility best practices. There are three opinion pieces and a brief roundup of startup funding news. This newsletter is for your information and includes links if you'd like to read more.

If you prefer a different mix of topics, update your preferences in your account. Thanks for reading and enjoy the weekend's articles.

Best regards,
The TechToday Team

subject: Your order #48291 has shipped
body:
Hi Casey,

Good news — your order #48291 has shipped and is on its way. The package is expected to arrive between June 9 and June 11. You can track the shipment using the link below. This email is just to let you know the item left our warehouse; no action is required unless you need to update the delivery address.

If you have any questions about the order, reply and our support team will help. Thank you for shopping with us.

Sincerely,
EcomHub Fulfillment

subject: Weekly site performance report — May 29
body:
Hi Team,

Attached is the automated weekly performance report for the marketing website covering traffic, conversion rates, and campaign attribution from May 22 to May 28. This is an informational digest generated by the analytics pipeline; please review at your convenience and add any comments to the shared doc if you want to discuss during next week's stand-up.

Regards,
Metrics Automation

subject: Brunch next week — confirmed
body:
Hey Jordan,

Just a quick note to say I'm looking forward to our brunch next Saturday. I booked a table for 10:30 at that new place on Maple. No need to reply unless you want to change the time or bring someone along. I'm happy to coordinate or adjust if your plans shift, but otherwise consider it set.

See you soon!

Love,
Emma

subject: Your subscription will renew next month
body:
Hello Marcus,

This is a reminder that your StreamFlix subscription is scheduled to renew on July 1. We will charge the card ending in 2345 unless you update your payment method or cancel your plan. This is an automated notification to keep you informed; no action is required if you wish to continue your subscription.

If you have questions about billing or want to change your plan, visit your account settings or reply and our billing team will assist.

Warm regards,
StreamFlix Billing

subject: Appointment reminder: June 14 at 9:00 AM
body:
Hello Jordan,

This is a reminder of your dental cleaning appointment scheduled for June 14 at 9:00 AM with hygienist Laura. If you need to reschedule, please call our office at least 24 hours in advance; otherwise, we look forward to seeing you on that date. This message is just a friendly reminder and does not require a response unless you need help changing the appointment.

Take care,
Smile Clinic

subject: URGENT: The coffee situation is dire
body:
Hi Team,

BREAKING: There is only one packet of premium dark roast left in the office kitchen. Immediate triage is required or productivity will plummet. I'm kidding, of course, but could someone restock the communal coffee supplies before Wednesday? I will personally offer my eternal gratitude and baked goods to any brave soul who tackles the caffeine crisis.

No formal action needed if you prefer, but if you volunteer I will add you to the official office hero list. Thanks for tolerating my dramatics.

Cheers,
Ben

subject: EMERGENCY: Chapter 7 cliffhanger
body:
Hello Book Club,

I can't sleep because of what happened at the end of Chapter 7. This is a literal emergency. Please bring your calmness, your theories, and snacks to Wednesday's meeting so we can unpack the trauma together. Sarcasm aside, I'm really eager to hear everyone's take — no one is obliged to solve the mystery before then.

See you at 7 PM. Promise this is not an actual crisis, only a strong emotional reaction to fantastic storytelling.

Hugs,
Lily

subject: Confirm materials so we can meet the site schedule
body:
Hi Olivia,

Thanks for approving the design changes. To keep the project on track for the scheduled site installation the week of June 20, we need to confirm the final material selections and shipping address as soon as possible. The fabricator needs a green light to begin cutting and lead times are already tight. If you can review the attached material board and confirm which options we should order, we can ensure delivery aligns with the installation crew.

Please let me know today or early tomorrow so we don't impact the installation schedule.

Best,
Mark

subject: Thesis draft and advisor feedback
body:
Dear Sam,

I reviewed your introduction and I think you have a strong start. The department begins final reviews next week and advisors will need drafts to prepare comments. If you want formal feedback prior to that period, please upload your full draft so I can read it over the weekend. Without a draft in time for reviews, you will miss the chance for my detailed comments before grading begins.

Let me know if you foresee any obstacles and we can arrange a brief meeting.

Regards,
Prof. Lucia Gomez

subject: Unacceptable delays in our account
body:
Jordan,

I am extremely frustrated with how our account issues have been handled over the past month. Multiple deadlines were missed, and every update seems to require chasing several people down. This lack of responsiveness is hurting our operations and reflects poorly on your company. I expect a clear plan explaining how you will resolve the backlog, but I do not need constant emails promising action without results.

Fix the outstanding items and provide a single point of contact. I look forward to substantial improvement.

Sincerely,
Carlos Alvarez

subject: URGENT SALE: Prices reduced forever!
body:
Hello Shopper,

URGENT SALE: For a very limited time our entire summer line is marked down. This exclusive, time-sensitive offer is live online and in-store, but no need to rush if you prefer to browse. The promotion is part of our monthly marketing push and will be available throughout the weekend. Click the link to see the sale items and apply your coupon at checkout.

This message uses urgency-style language to encourage browsing; there is no action required unless you want to make a purchase.

Thanks,
BargainKing Marketing Team

subject: Concern about contract performance — please call
body:
Hi Jordan,

I need to speak with you as soon as you are available. Our client has raised serious issues about deliverable quality and is considering escalating to legal counsel if we cannot show an immediate remediation plan. I understand the team has been stretched, but this is now a client relationship at risk and I need to coordinate next steps with you directly.

Please call me at 555-0123 when you see this email. I appreciate your prompt attention; an email reply will not suffice for this discussion.

Thanks,
Lauren Pierce

subject: I'll stop by Friday to drop off the mower
body:
Hey Nora,

Just a heads-up that I'll stop by Friday with the mower I mentioned so you can try it out before you decide to buy. I don't need anything from you except to be around so I can leave it on your porch if you're not home. No rush on your part — just letting you know the plan so you can expect me sometime that day.

If Friday doesn't work, tell me another time and I'll swing by then.

Cheers,
Jake

subject: Registration confirmed for the City Marathon
body:
Hello Patricia,

Thank you for registering for the City Marathon on August 12. This email confirms your entry in the 10K wave. Your bib and further event details will be mailed to the address on file approximately two weeks before race day. This notice is simply to confirm your registration; you do not need to respond unless your contact information is incorrect.

If you have questions about packet pickup or volunteer opportunities, visit our FAQ page or reply and we'll point you in the right direction.

Warm regards,
City Marathon Team

subject: New match: Ava liked your profile
body:
Hi Jordan,

Good news — Ava liked your profile and you're a match! We connected you in the app so you can start a conversation. This automated message is just to let you know; there's no pressure to respond immediately. If you'd like tips on starting a chat, check the conversation starter suggestions inside the app.

Enjoy getting to know your match, and reach out to support if you have any issues with the app.

Best,
LovelyApp Team

subject: Immediate action required: Account compromise detected
body:
Hello,

Our monitoring flagged suspicious activity on your corporate account this morning. We observed multiple failed login attempts from an unfamiliar IP and one successful access from a location that does not match your usual travel pattern. To secure your account, we require you to reset your password and complete a two-factor re-enrollment within the next two hours. Failure to take action will temporarily lock the account to prevent further access.

Please click the secure link provided in the portal notification or contact the help desk immediately if you cannot complete the steps.

Regards,
IT Security Team
Acme Corporation

subject: Final decision needed today for Senior Engineer offer
body:
Hi,

Thanks again for interviewing with us. We have finished internal discussions and need your final decision on the Senior Software Engineer offer by 5:00 PM today. The candidate has requested a response because competing offers require them to confirm their acceptance this evening. We will need a yes/no on the proposed salary and start date so HR can finalize the paperwork.

If you have any last questions, please call me immediately. If we don’t hear back by the deadline, we may need to rescind the offer or extend it under different terms.

Best,
Sandra Lee
Hiring Committee

subject: Consent required today for tomorrow's procedure
body:
Dear Patient,

This is a reminder regarding the cardiac catheterization scheduled for tomorrow morning. Our records indicate we have not yet received your signed consent form. Hospital policy requires signed consent at least 12 hours prior to the procedure. If we do not have the consent on file, the team will be unable to proceed and your appointment will be canceled.

Please review, sign, and return the attached consent form via the patient portal or bring the signed copy to pre-op tonight. If you have questions or concerns, contact our scheduling nurse as soon as possible.

Sincerely,
Scheduling Office
St. Mary’s Hospital

subject: Suspected fraudulent transaction — immediate verification needed
body:
Hello,

We detected an attempted transaction on your debit card that appears inconsistent with your typical spending pattern: a high-value transfer initiated from overseas this morning. To protect your funds, we have temporarily blocked outgoing transactions from your account until we can verify this activity with you.

Please call our 24/7 fraud hotline at the number listed below or reply securely through your online banking message center within the hour to confirm whether you authorized this transaction. If you do not respond, the block will remain and additional verification steps may be required when you next use your card.

Thank you,
Fraud Prevention Team
Capital Trust Bank

subject: Signature required today for merger confidentiality agreement
body:
Hi,

Following our earlier discussions, the confidentiality agreement for the proposed partnership has been finalized and sent to your inbox. We need your signed copy returned by the close of business today so we can proceed with the information exchange tomorrow morning. The board expects this timeline to be met to keep negotiations on schedule.

If there are any redlines you believe are necessary, highlight them immediately and schedule a brief call. Absent signed acknowledgment today, we risk delaying the deal and potentially losing this window.

Regards,
Thomas Reed
General Counsel
Bright Marketing

subject: Student org registration form due Friday
body:
Hello Student Leader,

This is a friendly reminder that your student organization’s annual registration form is due by Friday. The online form asks for officer contact details, a brief description of activities, and confirmation of advisor information.

If you’ve already submitted it, thank you — no further action is needed. If not, please take a few minutes to fill it out so we can finalize records before the semester activities begin.

Best regards,
Campus Activities Office

subject: Open enrollment benefits selection — deadline next Monday
body:
Hi,

Open enrollment for employee benefits closes next Monday. If you wish to make changes to your health plan, add dependents, or enroll in the flexible spending account, please log into the benefits portal and submit your selections before the deadline. BlueWave Health

body:

If you plan to bring a dish, please indicate what type (main, side, dessert) and whether it contains common allergens. If you won’t be contributing food but can bring chairs or help with set-up, please mark that as well. Your quick response helps us coordinate smoothly.

Regards,
Marta Gonzalez
Block Party Committee

subject: Mandatory safety quiz completion by end of week

PeakFit Club

body:

subject: URGENT: Your coffee mug situation is catastrophic
body:
Hey,

This is an extremely urgent communique: your coffee mug situation has reached levels that may threaten office productivity. I placed it on the communal dishwasher pile, but frankly, it’s a brittle peace we’re all pretending to maintain. If you’d like to rescue it before it suffers the indignity of being labeled Miscellaneous Mug #17, come by the kitchen when you get a chance.

Obviously, this is not a real emergency — unless you’re very attached to that mug. See you around.

Cheers,
Ben

subject: Enough is enough about your late-night music
body:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing because the late-night music from your apartment last weekend was completely unacceptable. My family was woken at 2:30 a.m., and this is not the first time. I expect basic courtesy from neighbors and residents, not a repeated disturbance that prevents sleep. I am not interested in excuses; I want the loud music to stop and for you to be mindful of your neighbors’ right to quiet.

If this continues, I will pursue further action with building management. Enough is enough.

Karen
Apartment 3B

subject: URGENT SALE: 72-Hour Mega Deal — Prices Won’t Last!
body:
Hello Shopper,

subject: Speaker confirmation for panel — slots fill rapidly
body:
Dear Dr. Morales,

We are finalizing the program for the upcoming summit and would very much like to include you on the Thursday afternoon panel. We have a limited number of speaking slots and they typically fill within a day or two as speakers confirm. If you are able to participate, please reply with your availability and a short bio so we can reserve a slot for you.

If we don’t hear from you shortly, we may need to offer the slot to another invited speaker. Please let us know at your earliest convenience.

Warm regards,
Evelyn Park
Conference Chair

subject: Hotel room block expiring — hold pending your approval
body:

We placed a tentative hold on a block of rooms for the client visit next month, but the hotel has informed us that the hold can only be maintained for 48 hours without a guarantee. If you would like us to convert the hold to a guaranteed reservation (which would secure the rate) we need your approval or a credit card on file to confirm.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Travel Desk

subject: I'll stop by by Friday — catch up soon!
body:
Hey!

It’s been too long. I’m planning to be in town next week and I’ll stop by by Friday if that still works for you. I’d love to catch up over coffee and see how your renovation turned out. If Friday is inconvenient, I’m flexible and we can pick another day — just let me know what works for your schedule.

Looking forward to seeing you and hearing all the updates. No rush — ping me when you have a moment.

Best,
Marcus

subject: We need to speak about the recent deliverable — serious concerns
body:
Hi Daniel,

I’m reaching out because our executive team reviewed the project deliverable you submitted and found several critical discrepancies that could materially affect our public launch. We’re quite concerned about the potential reputational impact and the board is asking for immediate clarification. This is urgent from our perspective and we’d prefer a direct conversation to walk through the issues.

Please call me as soon as you can today; if I don’t reach you, I’ll try your mobile. This cannot wait until next week because the launch timeline is tight and stakeholders are already engaged.

Sincerely,
Alyssa Chen
Client Relations
Verde Consulting

subject: Family has serious concerns about discharge instructions
body:
Dear Dr. Patel,

The family of Mr. Hargrove contacted our office this morning with serious concerns regarding the discharge instructions and medication reconciliation from his recent stay. They report that several medications are missing from the list and that symptoms described in the instructions differ from what the nurse communicated. They are quite upset and asking that a physician or pharmacist speak with them directly to clarify the plan.

Please contact the family today to address their concerns and prevent any potential readmission. If you prefer, I can coordinate a conference call at a time that suits you.

Thank you,
Maria Santos
Patient Liaison

subject: URGENT: Your desk plant staged a rebellion
body:
Hi,

Breaking news from the office jungle: your desk plant staged a rebellion and now occupies half the photocopier. We’re filing a formal protest to the plant union and requesting emergency watering measures. In the meantime, if you want to reclaim your workspace, it might be wise to come by and negotiate with Ficus. This is strictly a lighthearted note, but morale is high and the succulent has never been prouder.

Stop by when you can — no real emergency here unless you consider plant diplomacy a crisis.

Cheers,
Lena

subject: Unacceptable service on my last order
body:
To Whom It May Concern,

I received my order last week in pieces and your customer support has been useless. I have sent three emails and all I get are canned responses that do nothing. This level of service is unacceptable and I expect better from a company of your size. Fix the refund or replace the product immediately.

I am frustrated and will escalate this on social media if it is not resolved. I’m not asking politely any longer; please resolve this issue.

Frank Donovan

subject: URGENT CLEARANCE: Last chance to grab our limited sofas
body:
Hello,

Urgent clearance event happening now! Our warehouse is clearing out last season’s sofas and chairs. Prices have been drastically reduced, and once inventory is gone, there will be no restock. If you’ve had your eye on a particular item, this is your last opportunity to purchase at these prices.

Click through to view the selection. Shipping times vary depending on availability. No obligation if you’re just browsing — these messages are to help you find a great deal.

Best,
FlashFurniture Promotions

subject: I'll bake your birthday cake by Friday — super excited!
body:
My dear,

I wanted to let you know I’ll bake your birthday cake by Friday and bring it to your party. I’ve been trying a new recipe and I think you’ll love it. I’ll check in on the decorations and help set up if you want. I just need to know whether you prefer chocolate or lemon, but otherwise all is set on my end.

No need to do anything urgent; just send me a quick note about the flavor when you can.

Love,
Aunt Ruth

subject: Revision requested — reviewers awaiting your response
body:
Dear Dr. Singh,

Thank you for submitting your manuscript. The reviewers provided constructive feedback and the editorial board is inclined to accept pending revisions. Typically, authors return revised manuscripts within two weeks so that the review cycle can be completed before our next editorial meeting. Several reviewers have indicated they can re-evaluate promptly if we receive the revision soon.

Please submit your revised manuscript and a response to reviewer comments at your earliest convenience so we can proceed. If you need more time, let us know so we can adjust reviewer assignments.

Kind regards,
Monica Reyes
Editor-in-Chief

subject: Immediate Action Required: Unusual Sign-in — Reset Your Password Now
body:
Hi Jordan,

Our systems detected an unusual sign-in to your Acme account from a new device and location. For your protection we’ve temporarily restricted access. Please reset your password within the next two hours to restore full access and review recent activity. If you do not act within that window, we will enforce a temporary lock and you will need to verify identity with HR to regain access.

Follow the link in your account portal or contact the security team directly if you did not initiate this activity.

Thanks,
IT Security Team
Acme Corporation

subject: Final Reminder: Benefits Enrollment Closes Tomorrow
body:
Hello Casey,

This is the final reminder that open enrollment for 2026 benefits closes tomorrow at 11:59 PM. If you have not selected your medical plan and dependent coverage, please log into the benefits portal and complete your elections today. Changes made after the deadline cannot be processed until next year, and missing the enrollment will default you to the basic plan with no dependent coverage.

If you need assistance navigating the portal, reply to this message or call the benefits hotline and we’ll walk you through the steps.

Best,
Benefits Team

subject: URGENT: Potential Fraud on Your Account — Call Required
body:
Dear Maria,

We detected multiple high-value withdrawals from your checking account that appear inconsistent with your usual activity. To protect your funds we placed a temporary hold on outgoing transfers. Please call our Fraud Prevention line immediately at 1-800-555-0199 from a phone number on file so we can verify transactions and, if necessary, issue a provisional credit.

If we cannot reach you within four hours we will escalate the hold and additional verification will be required when you next attempt any transfers.

Sincerely,
Fraud Prevention Team
National Bank

subject: Decision Needed Today: Launch Feature Toggle for Retail Release
body:
Hi Dev Team,

We need a firm decision today on whether to enable the dynamic pricing feature for the retail release scheduled for Monday. QA has flagged a minor edge-case but product leadership needs your recommendation: ship with the toggle on, ship with toggle off, or delay the release until the bug is resolved. Please reply with your recommended option and a short rationale by 5 PM so we can finalize communications and coordinate with marketing.

I know this is late notice, but this decision determines the release notes and customer messaging sequence.

Thanks,
Alison
VP Product

subject: URGENT: Flight Cancelled — Rebooking Required Before Tonight
body:
Hi Sam,

Your outbound flight to Denver for Tuesday has been cancelled due to schedule changes from the airline. We need to confirm rebooking options before tonight to secure alternate flights at a comparable fare. Please let us know whether you prefer an earlier flight, later same-day flight, or an overnight option. If we do not hear from you within six hours we will automatically rebook the most economical option and notify you of the new itinerary.

Reply with your preferred alternative and any seating or connection constraints.

Regards,
Travel Desk
Global Meetings

subject: Quick Favor: Class Survey Due Friday
body:
Hello Dr. Patel,

We hope you are doing well. As part of our annual alumni outreach, we kindly ask that you complete a short survey about your recent class reunion experience. The survey takes less than five minutes and helps us plan next year’s events. Please submit your responses by Friday to ensure your feedback is included in our planning report.

We appreciate your time and continued support of the university. If you have any trouble accessing the survey, reply and we’ll assist.

Warmly,
Alumni Relations
State University

subject: Submission Reminder: Peer Review Due by End of Week
body:
Hi Jordan,

A friendly reminder that your peer review assignment for Module 3 needs to be submitted before the end of the week to earn full participation credit. The process is straightforward: review two classmates’ posts and provide constructive feedback using the rubric in the assignment page. Late submissions will still be accepted but may receive reduced credit.

If you have any questions about the rubric or need an extension, please contact the TA as soon as possible.

Best,
Course Administration Team

subject: Speaker Bio & Headshot Needed by This Friday
body:
Dear Priya,

We’re finalizing the speaker lineup for the GreenTech conference and need your short bio and headshot by this Friday so we can complete the program and badges. Please send a 75–100 word bio and a high-resolution photo. If we do not receive these items, we will use the information from your submission form and a stock silhouette for your badge.

Thanks for helping us keep the schedule on track. Let us know if you need more time.

Kind regards,
GreenTech Events Team

subject: Sign-Up Deadline for Weekend Cleanup
body:
Hi Taylor,

We’re organizing a neighborhood cleanup this Saturday and need volunteers to sign up by Thursday evening so we can order supplies and assign teams. If you’re available for a two-hour shift in the morning, please fill out the quick form linked below with your preferred time slot. This is a low-pressure, friendly event; we just need headcounts to plan refreshments and equipment.

Appreciate any help you can offer.

Cheers,
Neighborhood Volunteer Coordinator

FashionLane

Warmly,

body:

Evergreen Health Scheduling

body:

CI System

body:
Hello Neighbors,

Welcome to the June edition of the Riverdale Neighborhood newsletter. In this issue: updates on the community garden, a recap of last month’s block party, a schedule of upcoming meetings, and a short profile of a long-time resident. No action is required — just wanted to keep you informed about what’s happening locally.

If you have announcements for next month, reply to this email with details.

Best,
Riverdale Neighborhood Watch

body:
Hi Ana,

subject: Package Attempted Delivery — Pickup Info
body:
Hi Sam,

Our courier attempted to deliver your package today but there was no one available at the address. The package is being held at the local depot and can be picked up during business hours. If you would prefer redelivery, schedule it using the tracking link and choose a preferred time slot.

We’ll keep the item for five business days before returning it to the sender.

Thanks,
ParcelMate

subject: URGENT: Your Favorite Table Has Been Taken
body:
Hey—you won’t believe this.

I solemnly inform you that the corner table at Brew & Co., your sacred writing spot, has been stolen by a person who brought a laptop. Truly catastrophic. I demand immediate action: dramatic sighing, a strongly worded complaint, and perhaps a vigil. Clearly this is an emergency of the highest order and must be handled with coffee and pastries.

Call me when you can muster the courage to face this loss.

Always dramatic,
Claire

subject: Immediate Attention: Plants Are Wilting
body:
Hi,

I regret to report that the ficus in the reception area has developed a severe attitude problem and is shedding leaves. This crisis requires urgent counsel and possibly a watering session, though honestly therapy might be more appropriate. If you cannot spare a minute today to address this botanical emergency, I will file an official complaint with Facilities and stage a protest involving low-water banners.

All jokes aside, quick help would be appreciated but not mandatory.

Cheers,
Ron

subject: Approval Needed to Release This Week’s Production Run
body:
Hi Elena,

We’re queued to start the production run tonight but cannot proceed without your approval of the updated material specs. If we do not receive your sign-off before the line starts, the run will be delayed and alternative scheduling will push throughput into next week. The plant manager is waiting on a concise approval or requested change so tooling can be confirmed.

Please reply with approval or required modifications as soon as possible so we can avoid a costly delay.

Thanks,
Marcus
Manufacturing Operations

subject: Confirm Your Thesis Draft for Supervisor Review
body:
Hi Daniel,

Your committee would like to review a complete draft of your thesis before the end of the term so they can provide feedback during their summer schedules. We did not set a formal deadline, but the committee is booking review slots next week and needs a copy beforehand to allocate time. If you don’t submit soon, you may miss the opportunity for full feedback and risk a delayed defense date.

Please upload your draft to the portal or let me know if you need an extension.

Best,
Aisha

subject: Not Happy With Recent Service
body:
Hello Support,

I’m writing because I’m pretty frustrated. The repair technician missed the appointment window, left with the issue unresolved, and the follow-up has been slow. I expected better communication and more competent service given how much we’ve spent with your company. This has been an inconvenience and frankly unacceptable.

I don’t need a rushed apology email; I’d like to know what concrete steps you will take to fix this and when the technician will return. Please respond with a plan.

Regards,
Mike Jensen

This message is promotional in nature; no account action or response is required. Enjoy the deals if you’re in the market, and unsubscribe anytime via the link at the bottom.

Happy shopping,
BargainBlast Promotions
